name: Hyphal Extension
effect: Grow (forage): extend the mycelium one growth cycle (stepsPerGrow space-colonization iterations), branching toward ALL sensed attractors within sensingRadius — side food piles, substrate patches, mineral edges. Spreads wide and mops up scattered nutrients. No targeting tap; resolves on play.
flavor: Apical tips elongate by turgor pressure, fanning out to colonise every nearby crumb of litter.
notes: GLOBAL targeting (no tap). The backbone of the starting deck (run 4-6 copies). Maps to actions.grow; play is FREE (you paid drawCostEnergy 8 to draw it). The OMNIDIRECTIONAL forage member of the grow trio: spreads to all sensed attractors. Pairs against Apical Drive (player-aimed single direction) and Foraging Fan (radial 1-step). No goal-pathing (R8) — it follows sensed attractors, not the goal. familyKey:basics.

name: Apical Drive
effect: Aimed Grow: pick ONE compass direction; extend one growth cycle with the front committed to that aimed vector, pushing straight and far that way and ignoring attractors off the line. Reaches further along a chosen heading than the forage grow, but skips side caches off-axis.
flavor: Hyphae lock onto a single advance heading, ramming the front across open ground in one committed line.
notes: DIRECTIONAL targeting; growthAmount=1 cycle along the player-aimed vector. Replaces the CUT Chemotropic Probe but is player-AIMED (R8) — the player picks the direction, NOT 'toward the goal' and NOT obstacle-pathing. Genuine straight-vs-branch tradeoff with Hyphal Extension: committing to a heading skips off-axis side piles, so neither dominates. Best EARLY for crossing a known open gap. familyKey:basics.

name: Foraging Fan
effect: Radial Grow trick: push the front 1 step outward in EVERY direction at once, no substrate or attractor needed. Thickens and rounds out the colony perimeter rather than reaching far. Useful for re-seizing ground or fanning past a barrier with no nearby attractor to pull toward.
flavor: With no gradient to follow, the colony expands isotropically, a slow even ring of probing tips.
notes: GLOBAL-radial growth trick (R3b: 'grow 1 in every direction, no substrate needed'); growthAmount=1 omnidirectional step. No tap. Distinct from the two reaching grows: shortest reach but unconditional and attractor-free, so it works on a barren stretch where Hyphal Extension stalls for lack of a sensed attractor. Not auto-include: wasteful when a clear attractor or aimed line would carry you further per play. familyKey:basics.

name: Tropic Lunge
effect: Growth trick: drive the front 3 steps toward the NEAREST sensed substrate or food attractor, even if that attractor is just BEYOND sensingRadius — reaching out to grab a patch normally out of reach. UNPLAYABLE (greyed out) if no attractor is sensed at all — no do-nothing fallback.
flavor: Starved tips strain past their normal sensing horizon, lunging for the faintest trace of nutrient.
notes: FIXED per reviewer (high): removed the self-contradictory fallback ('no attractor sensed, yet grow toward nearest attractor within range'); the card is now UNPLAYABLE when no attractor is sensed (R7 — no do-nothing branch). DIRECTIONAL-to-attractor growth trick (R3b: 'grow 3 toward the nearest sensed substrate even if out of range'); growthAmount=3 toward nearest attractor. Targets the attractor, not the goal (R8). Distinct from Apical Drive (player-aimed) and Hyphal Extension (forage all): this one over-reaches to a single nearest attractor. Not auto-include: greyed out on open ground with no attractor, so you must have a patch/pile in or just past range to fire it. familyKey:basics.

name: Leaf Litter Cache
effect: Add Substrate (small): pick a direction; deposit a SMALL nutrient patch at the EDGE of current sensing range in that direction, creating a fresh attractor the next Grow will branch toward. Player controls direction, not distance.
flavor: Saprotrophs pre-position on a thin scatter of decaying leaf litter, seeding the next colonisation front.
notes: DIRECTIONAL targeting; patchSize=small (R3: patch dropped at sensing-range EDGE in chosen direction, player picks direction NOT distance). Smallest member of the substrate size family (small->medium->large). Maps to actions.addSubstrate, play FREE. Strong EARLY for routing a Grow where you want; near-dud LATE (no time to grow into it). Not auto-include: wasted if no follow-up Grow is queued. familyKey:basics.

name: Humus Bed
effect: Add Substrate (medium): pick a direction; deposit a MEDIUM nutrient patch (a wider, richer attractor than Leaf Litter Cache) at the EDGE of current sensing range in that direction. Pulls the next Grow harder and feeds more Digest later. Player controls direction, not distance.
flavor: A built-up bed of rotted humus offers a fat, slow-burning meal for the advancing front.
notes: DIRECTIONAL targeting; patchSize=medium (R3: sensing-range edge in chosen direction, direction only). The MIDDLE member of the substrate size family, sitting between Leaf Litter Cache (small) and Mycorrhizal Mat (large). A bigger attractor and a bigger later Digest yield than the small patch, but no reach difference — pure size differentiation per R3. Not auto-include: same routing-dependence as the small patch, just a heavier commit. familyKey:basics.

name: Mycorrhizal Mat
effect: Add Substrate (large): pick a direction; deposit a LARGE nutrient patch at the EDGE of current sensing range in that direction — a strong, wide attractor that bends the next Grow decisively and holds the most nutrient for later Digest. Player controls direction, not distance.
flavor: A symbiotic mat of mycelium and rootlets lays down a broad, nutrient-dense colonisation target.
notes: DIRECTIONAL targeting; patchSize=large (R3: sensing-range edge in chosen direction, direction only). LARGEST member of the substrate size family. Biggest attractor pull and the richest later Digest reservoir, but identical placement rule to the smaller patches (size is the only lever, R3). Best MID when you want to firmly redirect the front or bank fuel for Digest. Not auto-include: overkill for a quick reroute where the small/medium patch suffices, and wasted LATE. familyKey:basics.

name: Saprotrophic Digest
effect: Digest (global): drain 1 nutrient from EVERY occupied substrate patch under your network at once, converting each drained unit into a SMALL one-shot energy refund (+1 energy per occupied patch drained). Repeated uses strip the substrate further. Affects all occupied patches, never a chosen cell.
flavor: Secreted cellulases and ligninases break litter into absorbable sugars across the whole colonised mat.
notes: FIXED per reviewer (low): refund realigned to the locked digest base=1 model (R5). Digest base rate = 1 flat nutrient per occupied patch (replaces the old drainFraction 0.5); refund is +1 energy per occupied patch drained — flat, no percentages, scales only with how much substrate you've colonised. GLOBAL targeting (R4: hits ALL occupied substrate, never a specific cell). One-shot energy, NOT an engine (no per-round produce, repayRounds 0) so it cannot break the idle/clock invariant. On a small network (1-5 patches) the refund stays below drawCost 8, so spamming it to draw is net-negative — it only pays off when you have broad substrate you were going to abandon. Relief valve when energy is tight; a waste when you'd rather keep the substrate as a live attractor. familyKey:basics.

name: Appressorial Punch
effect: Drive a melanin-walled appressorium into the nearest in-range BOULDER (lone 1-cell rock) toward the goal, clearing that one whole rock so growth can pass — no Phosphorus needed. Clears boulders only; cannot touch formations, columns, or the lake basin. UNPLAYABLE (greyed out) if no boulder is in sensing range — no do-nothing fallback.
flavor: A melanin-walled appressorium builds enormous turgor to drive a penetration peg through the rock — up to ~8 MPa, as in Magnaporthe.
notes: DIRECTIONAL single-rock target: clears the SINGLE nearest in-range BOULDER toward the goal (R6/R8 — the one approved directional rock case; one whole rock, no distance counting, no cell IDs). clears:['boulder'] = Tier-1 dig, the lightest rung of the terrain ladder; formations/columns/lake-basin still need the real P-gated dig events. NO weak-Grow fallback — if no boulder is in range the card is UNPLAYABLE (R6: no do-nothing). Free floor basic, not resource-gated (keeps the basic floor playable when resource-dry). Not auto-include: useless on an open route with no boulder. familyKey:basics.

name: Sclerotial Crust
effect: Protect (radius): tap a point; every hyphal segment within a SMALL radius (40) hardens into a melanised crust, immune to infection and eating for 2 rounds. Walls off a threatened pocket of the network from mould or nematodes. The player controls only where the tap lands.
flavor: Hyphae aggregate into a hard, melanin-blackened sclerotial rind that pathogens cannot breach.
notes: RADIUS-AROUND-A-TAP targeting; radius=40 (small member of the protect/heal radius family, copying the Amputate radius-60 primitive). Replaces the CUT Septal Plug, which was single-node (R7 — illegal on phone); same reactive-defense identity, now radius-based (R7/R9). Dead card if no threat is near the tapped pocket (NOT auto-include); valuable when a mould cloud or nematode swarm is about to chew your only route. 2-round window forces timing — play too early and immunity lapses before the threat arrives. Free floor basic, ungated. familyKey:basics.

name: Brown-Rot Mat
effect: Install. Gain +4 energy at the end of each round for its first 3 rounds installed, then +2 energy/round thereafter.
flavor: Brown-rot hyphae strip cellulose and hemicellulose straight out of dead leaf litter, leaving the brown lignin skeleton behind.
notes: REVIEWER FIX (high/dominance): re-profiled from +3x5-then-+2 to a sharper front-load (+4 for 3 rounds, then +2) so it no longer sits strictly dominated by Rhizomorph Trunkline. Distinct identity: Mat is the EARLY burst engine (highest output in its first 3 rounds, then decays to a trickle), Trunkline is the steady mid-to-late anchor (+4 flat forever). Install Mat early to front-load setup energy; install Trunkline as a long-haul cord. Real 'too late' read: drafted late, Mat's burst window is short and it underpays. Repay 14/(~4 early value)~=3 rounds, common band. CEILING: counts its MAX +4 toward the energy-engine sum (Mat 4 + later +2 stacks safely under 12 with the runtime clamp). Pure energy engine -> NO W/P/N gate (no double-tax). One unique copy (R11).

name: Rhizomorph Trunkline
effect: Install a thick conductive cord. Gain +4 energy at the end of each round.
flavor: A melanised rhizomorph - a bundled cable of hyphae that pumps water and nutrients in bulk across long underground runs.
notes: The single biggest per-round energy engine allowed (+4 = the per-engine cap). Pure energy engine: NO W/P/N gate (no double-tax). Flat buy 14, repay 14/4~=3 rounds (uncommon band). CEILING: +4 alone, or +4 (Trunkline) +4-warm (Brown-Rot Mat) handled by the runtime clamp at skip-1=11 -> idle always net-negative. The clamp, not buy cost, is the lever (R12). Distinct from Brown-Rot Mat post-fix: flat +4 forever (steady long-haul anchor) vs Mat's +4-for-3-then-+2 early burst -> Mat better early, Trunkline better as a sustained mid/late cord.

name: Septal Pore Flux
effect: Install. Drawing a basic from your draw deck costs 3 less energy (minimum 1 per draw).
flavor: Cytoplasm streams freely through the septal pores between hyphal compartments, ferrying material to the growing front at low cost.
notes: R11: dropped the 'does not stack' clause (one unique copy). Savings engine, NOT idle income -> produces 0 energy while card-dry (nothing to draw), EXEMPT from the energy-ceiling sum, never touches the idle-negative invariant. At ~1.5 draws/round it saves ~4.5 energy-equiv/round -> repay 14/~5~=3 rounds (common band). Pairs with extenders; useless once the deck depletes (LATE) -> strong early, dead late. Pure savings: no W/P/N gate.

name: Sclerotium Reserve
effect: Install. At end of round, if you spent NO energy this round AND you are not card-dry (you still have cards to draw), store +3 reserve (maximum 8 stored). On the first end-of-round in which you DO spend energy, release ALL stored reserve as energy. Cannot store or release while card-dry.
produces: deferred energy (store on active idle, release on act; disabled card-dry)
flavor: A hardened, dormant survival body that hoards carbon through lean stretches and mobilises it the instant growth resumes.
notes: REVIEWER FIX (high/clock-break): (1) max stored lowered from 15 to 8 (< skip 12) so a single release can never fund more than one extra round; (2) HARD CARD-DRY LOCKOUT added - it cannot store OR release once card-dry, so it can no longer convert the terminal SKIP bleed into a lump and prolong the 'die at 0 while card-dry' clock. Now strictly an ACTIVE-phase survival/insurance tool: bank during active idle, release when you resume spending. INVARIANT preserved: cannot create net energy (only returns energy you refrained from spending); SKIP still costs full 12. Flat buy 14, NO P-gate (defensive card, not mis-taxed). Axis defense; repay 4 (uncommon band) as the situational active-stretch break-even. Exempt from the energy-ceiling sum (no idle income, and now provably cannot tick in the dry tail). One unique copy.

name: Oxalate Exudate Network
effect: Play (costs 2 Phosphorus). Install. At the end of each round, gain +1 of a resource you choose at INSTALL (lock in Water, Phosphorus, or Nitrogen) - never energy.
flavor: Hyphae weep oxalic acid that dissolves apatite and silicate rock, freeing locked phosphorus and minerals into the network (no plant partner - pure mineral weathering).
notes: REVIEWER FIX (low+medium/double-flavor & lint ambiguity): REMOVED the one-time +10 energy install burst entirely. It is now a CLEAN resource engine - produces ZERO energy (one-time or per-round), so it carries NO produce.energy at all and cannot trip invariant-4 (no energy+W/P/N double-tax) no matter how cardlint scopes one-time vs per-round energy. Truly EXEMPT from the energy ceiling (a pure resource engine). The locked resource choice at install = real commitment (not auto-include). P-gated (2 P) purely because its POWER is resource generation. +1 resource ~=3.5 energy-equiv/round repays the flat-14 buy in ~4 rounds once you account for routing to mine 2 P first (rare band, scaling via the locked-resource flexibility, not raw rate). Renamed from Mycorrhizal Exchange (no plant partner in this world).

name: Osmotic Cashout
effect: Exhaust (one-shot, costs 1 Water). Immediately gain +22 energy. Does not advance the round.
flavor: Accumulated glycerol and polyols, drawn in with water, are catabolised in a sudden pulse of metabolic energy.
notes: REVIEWER FIX (medium/dominance): raised from +18 to +22 so the 1-Water gate buys a meaningful premium over the ungated burst counterpart (Hyphal Investment, +18 total spread over 3 rounds, no gate). Clean dominance split now: Cashout = INSTANT, all-at-once, ANY timing, can rescue a one-round liquidity crisis, but spends a scarce Water + competes with growth/dig cards for it (sequencing tension); Hyphal Investment = FREE but slow drip, EARLY only, cannot bail you out instantly. One-shot event, NOT an engine -> repayRounds 0, no idle interaction (can't tick), exempt from the energy ceiling. Targeting global (resolves on play, no tap). Renamed from Turgor Surge.

name: Laccase Cascade
effect: Install. ACTION (once per 3 rounds): digest decay/litter across the whole network for +8 energy. Firing this action does NOT count as your forward move: if you take no draw or other forward action that round you still pay SKIP. Cannot be used in a round you press SKIP.
produces: +8 energy per activation (every 3rd round, on demand)
flavor: Laccase oxidises lignin's phenolic rings, unlocking the cellulose beneath - the hallmark oxidase of white-rot fungi.
notes: REVIEWER FIX (medium/invariant-4 ambiguity): REMOVED the 1 Nitrogen gate. It is an energy SOURCE, and per invariant-4 energy printers should not also be W/P/N-gated; the flat-14 buy + the 3-round cooldown + the 'still pay SKIP / cannot fire in a SKIP round' guard are now its ONLY levers (no double-tax, scope no longer ambiguous). Net payout +8 every 3rd round = +2.67/round amortised; cardlint counts that amortised output against the ENGINE-ENERGY SUM (energy engine in an action costume) and the dry-tail guard ensures a card-dry fire nets +8-12 SKIP < 0 so it cannot become a perpetual stall engine (INVARIANT 1). Targeting global (R4: digests ALL occupied substrate). Retagged threat:none (lost its N/worm interaction with the gate removed; it is pure digestion economy now). Repay ~5 (uncommon band). White-rot laccase = lignin, complements Cellulase Bloom = cellulose.

name: Fairy Ring
effect: Install. Gain +2 energy at end of round. Each time you harvest a food pile, the ring widens: permanently +1 to its end-of-round energy, hard-capped at +4 total. Energy output never exceeds +4.
produces: +2 to +4 energy/round (widens with piles harvested, hard-capped at +4)
flavor: The colony fruits in an ever-widening annulus, its exhausted core senescing behind the advancing front - the classic ring of Marasmius oreades.
notes: REVIEWER FIX (low/slow keep): cap raised from +3 to +4 (= the per-engine ceiling limit) and repay lowered 5->4 so the pile-harvest payoff is worth building around and the engine is no longer a weak keep vs Trunkline. Pure ENERGY engine -> NO W/P/N gate (the flat buy + repay clock + ceiling are its only levers; gating it would double-tax). HARD per-engine cap +4 baked in; cardlint registers it at MAX +4 for the ceiling sum (runtime clamp at skip-1=11 keeps any stack idle-negative). Signature timing-trap: drawn LATE it can never ramp through pile visits = near-dead; needs early-MID install + 2-3 pile harvests to reach +4 and repay ~4 (rare band, justified by the scaling ceiling, not raw rate). Targeting global. Marasmius oreades flavor.

name: Cellulase Bloom
effect: Install. Whenever you fully or partially harvest a food (leaf-litter) pile, that pile yields +6 energy (flat).
flavor: Induced cellulase shreds the cellulose in leaf litter, wringing more sugar from every cache of decaying matter (cellulose is cellulase's substrate, as lignin is laccase's).
notes: REVIEWER FIX (medium x2): (1) magnitude reduced +10 -> +6 per harvest, repay 4 -> 3. Since piles are mandatory for solvency the trigger is not a real constraint, so the power had to come down off the magnitude; +6 still nets ~+24-36 over a level (4-6 piles), repays after ~2-3 piles. No longer the strongest non-gated payoff / near-auto-include. (2) RETAGGED threat:ant -> threat:none - it has no ant counterplay (it neither contests, repels, nor converts ants); it is a pure harvest-economy engine, so it should not inflate the anti-ant column. R5: flat +6 (no percentages). R11: no 'does not stack' clause. On-harvest engine, NOT per-round energy -> EXEMPT from the energy ceiling (zero idle energy; fires only on a harvest event, idle bleed unchanged). LATE = too late (most piles passed). Pure energy effect: no W/P/N gate. Targeting global (applies to whichever pile you harvest).

name: Hyphal Investment
effect: Exhaust (one-shot). Gain +6 energy now, then +6 energy at the end of each of the next 2 rounds (total +18, paid out over 3 rounds). Does not advance the round when played.
flavor: The colony front-loads carbon into a forward push, drawing down reserves it will earn back as it spreads.
notes: The UNGATED counterpart to Osmotic Cashout: +18 total, no Water cost, PAID OUT over 3 rounds. Post-fix dominance split is clean -> Cashout is the burst (1 Water, +22, all at once, ANY timing, rescues a one-round crisis), this is the slow free drip (+18, EARLY, cannot bail you out instantly). One-shot event, repayRounds 0, exempt from the energy ceiling (cannot tick as an installed engine; the staged payout ends after round 3 and cannot extend the card-dry tail as recurring income). Targeting global, no tap. Pure energy: no W/P/N gate.

name: Polyphosphate Granule
effect: Install. While installed, raise your energy carry cap by 30 (160 to 190) FOR THE CURRENT LEVEL ONLY, and gain +2 energy at end of round for its first 4 rounds installed, then 0 thereafter. At level end the carry cap reverts to the base 160 before any carry-over is clamped.
produces: +2 energy/round (first 4 rounds) + raised in-level carry cap
flavor: Hyphae pack phosphate into dense storage granules, banking surplus against the lean dry tail ahead.
notes: REVIEWER FIX (low/cap invariant): the +30 carry-cap raise now applies to the CURRENT LEVEL ONLY and REVERTS to base 160 at level end BEFORE the carry-over clamp runs -> it can no longer carry up to 190 into the next level, so the energyCarryCap:160 'banking can't trivialize next level' invariant holds. The level-transition carry clamp must read the BASE cap (160), not the engine-modified cap. In-level the raised cap still lets a pile-rich early game bank surplus instead of wasting it. The +2/round lapses after 4 rounds (NOT permanent idle income; stops contributing to the ceiling after round 4); counts its +2 toward the energy-ceiling sum while active. Flat buy 14, repay ~4 (+2x4=8 energy plus the in-level headroom value). Pure energy engine: no W/P/N gate. EARLY identity: the cap headroom matters most before piles are harvested. Distinct from Sclerotium Reserve (which defers spend-or-not energy) - this raises the in-level ceiling on banked surplus.

name: Hydrophobin Bleed
effect: Install. ACTION (once per 2 rounds, MAXIMUM 4 fires per level): gain +9 energy now, but at the end of the NEXT round lose 3 energy (the metabolic debt). Cannot be used in a round you press SKIP, and firing it does NOT substitute for your forward move (you still pay SKIP if you take no draw/forward action).
produces: +9 energy now, -3 next round (net +6 per use, every 2 rounds, capped at 4 uses/level)
flavor: The colony sheds its protective hydrophobin coat to burn structural protein for a fast metabolic kick, paying interest as it rebuilds.
notes: REVIEWER FIX (medium x2/clock loophole): added a HARD PER-LEVEL CAP of 4 fires so the action channel can no longer be a perpetual uncapped energy faucet outside the engine clamp -> it is now a finite tempo tool (max +24 net over a level), not a clock-breaker. Anti-dry-tail guards retained and load-bearing: cannot fire in a SKIP round AND firing does NOT substitute for the forward move, so a card-dry fire nets +9 -12 SKIP -3 debt < 0 and cannot chain to fund the terminal bleed. Cardlint ACCOUNTING: scope the energy ceiling to PERSISTENT installed engines; energy-printing ACTIONS like this are governed instead by (a) the no-SKIP-substitute + no-SKIP-round guards and (b) the per-level fire cap. Its amortised net +6/2rounds = +3/round is tracked as tempo, finite. Net +6/use front-loaded with a delayed -3 bite -> punishes you if near zero next round (downside-tempo tension). Flat buy 14, repay ~4. Pure energy: no W/P/N gate (an energy action; gating it would double-tax per invariant-4 scoping). Hydrophobin flavor reserved here for the protein-burn theme.

name: Hyphal Imbibition
effect: If your network touches a lake edge, harvest +2 Water (counts as one of that lake edge's charges). Otherwise gain +1 Water from soil condensation.
flavor: Hyphae draw free water across their walls by simple osmotic imbibition; even dry soil yields a trickle of condensation.
notes: Floor water source, free deck-floor basic (buyCostEnergy 0, R2). GLOBAL targeting: checks whole-network lake adjacency, no tap. Never a full dud (inv. 6/7): +2 lakeside, +1 off-lake, but lakeside double yield keeps routing the point. Below the +3 lake-action so installs stay worth it. Payload of Capillary Runners. You still paid drawCostEnergy 8 to draw it.

name: Aquaporin Channels
effect: Install. Each round, produce +1 Water. Stops producing after it has made 8 Water total this level, then sits inert.
flavor: Membrane aquaporins gate a passive flux of water into the growing front until the channels foul and clog.
notes: GLOBAL resource engine (produces W, exempt from energy SUM ceiling, inv. 3; produce.energy 0 so no double-tax flag inv. 4). Lifetime cap 8 makes it strictly EARLY: install LATE and you waste most of the cap before card-dry (real 'too late' read). Repay 4 = flat 14 / ~3.5 resourceValueEquiv, standard band 4-5 (inv. 5). Capped output removes 'prints forever' dominance over the uncapped uncommon below.

name: Riparian Mycelium
effect: Install. Produce +1 Water/round, or +2 Water/round on any round your network is touching a lake edge.
flavor: A streamside colony thickens its cords along the shoreline, mainlining the lake.
notes: GLOBAL resource engine, uncapped but lake-position-gated (exempt from energy ceiling inv. 3; produce.energy 0, no double-tax inv. 4). Uncapped ceiling + shoreline condition is the trade vs the capped common at the SAME flat 14 — power lives in the condition, not price (R2). 2 W/round lakeside, 1 off-lake. Repay 5, uncommon band 4-5 assuming mixed positioning (inv. 5). Rewards routing to stay on shore.

name: Pressurized Turgor Cell
effect: Install. Each round, produce +1 Water. The first time each level you hold 6 or more Water, this engine charges: from then on it produces +2 Water/round.
flavor: A turgid sclerotium stores pressure, surging into a higher flux once fully charged.
notes: GLOBAL resource engine, exempt from energy ceiling (inv. 3; produce.energy 0, no double-tax inv. 4). Back-loaded rare CEILING: ramps to +2/round only AFTER you bank 6 Water (soft cap is 6, so this demands a committed water build) and only on a MID install with runway to charge — too LATE to charge is a trap. Dropped the old free-Grow rider (R7/keep it a clean resource engine). Repay 6, rare band 4-6 justified by the +2 ceiling (inv. 5). Weak until charged, not an auto-include.

name: Shoreline Anastomosis
effect: Install. Once every 2 rounds, if your network touches a lake edge, harvest +3 Water (counts as one of that lake edge's charges).
flavor: Fused hyphal bridges tap the lakebed, siphoning a pulse of water on a cooldown.
notes: GLOBAL-condition action (checks whole-network lake adjacency, no tap). Action not engine => repayRounds 0, no per-round produce, no energy-ceiling concern (inv. 5). Drains a finite lake (~3 charges/edge) so it is positionally and resource-finite gated, not an idle producer. Dead once lakes deplete or you leave shore (inv. 7). Strong only while parked at a live lake.

name: Capillary Runners
effect: Add 4 'Hyphal Imbibition' basics to your draw deck, then this card goes to the discard.
flavor: Thin capillary runners spread toward moisture, multiplying the colony's drinking surface.
notes: Runway extender: adds NEW basics, self goes to graveyard, no reshuffle (inv. 10). GLOBAL (no target). Adds the revised Hyphal Imbibition (never a full dud: worst case +1 W off-lake), but cards stay strongly lake-route-dependent for full value and you still pay drawCostEnergy 8 to draw each. EARLY: extends the deck-depletion clock toward a water build. Weak on a no-lake route, not an auto-include.

name: Hydraulic Boring
effect: Exhaust. Spend 2 Water: clear ONE whole rock-column or rock-formation, the nearest eligible one in sensing range (or the nearest eligible one toward the goal). Unplayable if no formation or column is in range.
flavor: Focused turgor and softening enzymes ream a fast tunnel straight through packed rock.
notes: Tier-3 dig band: clears FORMATION + ROCK-COLUMN (terrainLadder); declares clears:['formation','column']. Single rock-clear: nearest eligible in range, or nearest toward goal (the one approved directional exception, R6/R8). Whole-rock, no distance/cell counting (R6). UNPLAYABLE if no eligible rock in range (no do-nothing fallback, inv. 7). W-gate 2 (uncommon standard, R5) keeps the water identity for a barrier-break. Event/exhaust, repay 0.

name: Hydraulic Deluge Bore
effect: Exhaust. Spend 3 Water and 1 Phosphorus: collapse and clear ONE whole rock-column or the lake-basin, the nearest eligible one in sensing range (or the nearest eligible one toward the goal). Unplayable if no column or lake-basin is in range.
flavor: A pressurized flood front, salted with mineral acids, slumps an entire barrier into mud.
notes: Capstone water dig (Tier-4 band, terrainLadder): clears ROCK-COLUMN + LAKE-BASIN; declares clears:['column','lakeBasin']. The water family's answer to the impassable lake cross-section. Whole-rock, no cell counting (R6); nearest eligible or nearest toward goal (the one directional exception, R8). UNPLAYABLE if no eligible rock in range (inv. 7). Heavy gate 3 W + 1 P carries the power (inv. 4 ok: event, produce.energy 0; power in the gate not the flat-14 buy). LATE one-shot payoff, event repay 0. Demands a water build plus a phosphorus tap.

name: Rehydration Pulse
effect: Exhaust. Tap a point; spend 1 Water: heal mould/nematode damage and clear desiccation and rot from every strand cell within a small radius (radius 60) of the tap.
flavor: A flush of water re-pressurizes collapsed hyphae, reviving rotted and worm-bitten strands.
notes: RADIUS-around-a-tap, not per-strand (R7/R9). Uses the canonical Amputate radius 60 (small heal); declares radius 60. Cheap reactive water sink (1 W). Defense vs mould/worm. Dead on a clean board, never an auto-include (inv. 7). ANY timing, pays immediately, event repay 0. Threat 'all' (repairs any-source damage). Bottom of the radius-heal family (Rehydration 60 -> Monsoon 160), differentiated by RADIUS SIZE only.

name: Monsoon Bloom
effect: Exhaust. Tap a point; spend 3 Water: heal mould/nematode damage and clear desiccation and rot from every strand cell within a large radius (radius 160) of the tap.
flavor: A rain-fed flush drenches a whole quarter of the colony at once, every rotted cord drinking deep.
notes: LARGE RADIUS cleanse (radius 160), not whole-map (R9). Top of the radius-heal family (Rehydration 60 -> Monsoon 160), differentiated by RADIUS SIZE only (R7). Heavy 3 W gate carries the power (inv. 4: event, produce.energy 0; power in the gate not the flat-14 buy). LATE one-shot defensive payoff for a mould/worm-ravaged board; dead on a clean board (inv. 7). Demands a water build. Event repay 0.

name: Hydrophobin Sluice
effect: Install. Once every 3 rounds, spend 1 Water: where your network edge meets open water, lay a water-sealed crossing so the colony can grow across that lake or flooded basin as if it were solid ground. Unplayable if no network edge is at a lake or basin.
flavor: Hydrophobin coatings waterproof the front, letting the colony bridge open water it could never normally pass.
notes: Repeatable utility action (repay 0, no per-round produce, no energy-ceiling concern, inv. 5). POSITIONAL crossing at the network/lake boundary — no node/strand/cell id referenced (R7); resolves where the front already meets water, the player picks no specific strand. Turns lakes from obstacles into shortcuts. UNPLAYABLE when no edge touches a lake/basin (no do-nothing fallback, inv. 7). Each use costs 1 W + cooldown; useless on a lake-free path, situational, never auto-include. Self-synergy: spend the W you make.

name: Turgor Surge
effect: Exhaust. Spend 1 Water: grow 3 cells in a chosen direction, emanating from the network edge that way.
flavor: A bolt of turgor pressure jets the apical front forward along one chosen heading.
notes: DIRECTIONAL growth burst (R3b/R8): player aims one direction, growth emanates from that edge — NEVER 'toward the goal'. Declares growthAmount 3. Flat numbers (R5). Water sink (1 W), immediate tempo payoff, event repay 0, ANY timing. Gated by the W you must harvest first ('save it, detour to a lake'). Useless if water-starved or already positioned (inv. 7).

name: Capillary Fan
effect: Exhaust. Spend 1 Water: grow 1 cell in every direction from the network edge (no substrate needed).
flavor: Water wicks outward through every capillary at once, fanning the whole front a step wider.
notes: Growth-trick family (R3b): GLOBAL-radial 'grow 1 in EVERY direction, no substrate needed'. Declares growthAmount 1 (radial). Flat numbers (R5). Water sink 1 W, immediate, event repay 0. EARLY: best when the front is broad and you want sensing/coverage spread cheaply, vs Turgor Surge's focused 3-in-one-direction. Useless water-starved (inv. 7). Differentiated from Turgor Surge by shape (radial-all vs directional-3), not by number tricks.

name: Riptide Reach
effect: Exhaust. Spend 2 Water: grow 3 cells toward the nearest sensed substrate, even if it is out of normal sensing range.
flavor: A long surge of pressure flings a cord across the gap to the next moist patch.
notes: Growth-trick family (R3b): directional-to-ATTRACTOR — 'grow 3 toward the nearest sensed substrate even if out of range'. NOT toward the goal (R8); aims at the nearest sensed attractor. Declares growthAmount 3. Flat numbers (R5). The reach card that closes gaps between patches/piles, complementing the substrate family at range. Water sink 2 W (uncommon, R5), event repay 0, MID. Useless if no sensed substrate or water-starved (inv. 7).

name: Osmotic Lure
effect: Install. Each round, produce +1 Water, and extend your sensing range outward by a fixed amount while installed.
flavor: A moist halo of exudate swells around the colony, drawing distant patches into reach.
notes: GLOBAL resource engine + utility rider (exempt from energy ceiling inv. 3; produce.energy 0, no double-tax inv. 4). The sensing boost feeds the substrate/reach families (Riptide Reach, substrate-at-range-edge cards) — water as a map-opener, a distinct niche from the pure +1 producers. Uncapped +1 W but the value is split with sensing, justifying repay 5 in uncommon band 4-5 (inv. 5). EARLY install so the sensing pays off across the level; a LATE install wastes the runway. Flat numbers (R5).

name: Mineralize
effect: Play for free. Global: produce +1 Phosphorus.
flavor: Acid phosphatases cleave a little bound phosphate from the surrounding mineral grains.
notes: The free deck-floor P source the family needs (R2 basic, buyCostEnergy 0; you paid drawCostEnergy 8 to draw it). Global, no W/P/N gate, playCostEnergy 0. This is the basic that Polyphosphate Granule seeds into the deck. Gives the P economy a baseline so P-gated cards are never fully dead even on rock-light maps (pairs with the W<->P<->N converter elsewhere in the set). Targeting global (R7).

name: Phosphate Tap
effect: Play for free. Global: if your network is in contact with any mineral/crystal formation or boulder, harvest it for +3 Phosphorus. Unplayable if no phosphorus feature is in contact.
flavor: Cords sheathe a rock face and draw down its dissolved phosphate charge.
notes: The basic P HARVEST card the family direction explicitly asks for (parity with the basic W harvest). Free deck-floor; the canonical +3 harvest from CONFIG.resources.harvestPhosphorus. Global contact check (R7, no node/strand targeting). Unplayable when not in contact with a P feature (R6-style: no do-nothing fallback) -> rewards routing to rock first. Rhizomorph Drill upgrades this to +5.

name: Phosphatase Cushion
effect: Install. Global: each round, produce +1 Phosphorus. Stops producing after it has yielded 8 Phosphorus total, then sits inert. Produces no energy.
flavor: Secreted acid phosphatases cleave bound phosphate from soil minerals until the readily-accessible reserve is exhausted.
notes: Floor P engine with a HARD LIFETIME CAP of 8 P to kill the auto-include profile (R5 flat cap, no %). Flat buy 14; +1 P/round (~3.5 ev) -> repays in the common/early band only if installed early enough to drain the full 8-P reserve. Bought late, it yields only ~4-5 P before the goal -> 'too late to repay', restoring the early-or-trap read. Pure resource engine -> energy-ceiling EXEMPT (no produce.energy), no W/P/N gate (no double-tax). Global production, no targeting (R7).

name: Mineral Foraging Hyphae
effect: Install. Begins producing the round AFTER it is played: then global +1 Phosphorus each round. If it is in contact with a mineral/crystal formation, produce +2 Phosphorus each round instead.
flavor: Exploratory cords thread toward rock, foraging dissolved phosphate along chemotactic gradients.
notes: Workhorse P engine. One-round startup delay + conditional near-rock doubling lands break-even at ~4 rounds (uncommon band) at base rate, faster if routed to rock. Rewards spatial play via the +2 near-rock rider (global contact check, R7 -> no specific node). Resource engine -> energy-ceiling EXEMPT, no W/P/N gate. Flat buy 14. Distinct from Apatite Hyphae, whose ceiling is harvest spikes rather than near-rock doubling.

name: Apatite Hyphae
effect: Install. Global: each round, produce +1 Phosphorus. Whenever you harvest a mineral/crystal formation, gain +3 additional Phosphorus.
flavor: Hyphae exude oxalic and citric acids that etch phosphate from rock, leaving biogenic crystal casts where the cords pried the mineral open.
notes: Base +1 P/round (~3.5 ev) so its steady drip does not shadow Mineral Foraging Hyphae; the rare's CEILING is the +3-per-harvest burst, realized only if you route to and repeatedly harvest formations (pairs with Rhizomorph Drill + Phosphate Tap). Flat buy 14, band-correct repay ~5 on the drip alone, faster with harvests. Late play is a trap (no rounds left to bank drip OR run harvests) -> a true MID engine. Resource engine, energy-ceiling EXEMPT, no W/P/N gate. Global; harvest-trigger is the existing global harvest event, not a node target (R7).

name: Saprotrophic Lattice
effect: Install. Global: each round, produce +1 Phosphorus. Additionally, the FIRST time each round any of your strands is eaten or rotted by a threat, produce +1 Phosphorus (recycled from the loss). At most +1 from this rider per round.
flavor: Decomposer enzymes scavenge phosphate from dying tissue, turning attrition into raw material.
notes: KEEP (playtest like). Anti-fragile P engine. Base +1 P/round = ~5-round repay (uncommon band); the threat-loss rider is explicitly capped at +1/round so it can never spike P faster than one extra per round even in swarms -> bounds the feed into P-gated power. Strong in high-threat levels, average in clean ones -> state-dependent, never auto-include. Resource engine -> energy-ceiling EXEMPT, no W/P/N gate. Flat buy 14. Rider triggers on a GLOBAL loss event (R4/R7), not a chosen strand.

name: Rhizomorph Drill
effect: Install. ACTION (once per 2 rounds): if your network is in contact with a mineral/crystal formation, harvest it for +5 Phosphorus instead of the usual +3. The formation still depletes one harvest's worth. Unplayable when no formation is in contact.
flavor: Melanized rhizomorphs bore like rootlike cables, prying open mineral seams under turgor pressure.
notes: Repeatable mining upgrade, not an engine (repayRounds 0; value is conditional on reaching rock -> no idle-energy concern, energy-ceiling N/A). Turns a ~9-P formation into ~15 P over its life. Unplayable if no formation in contact (R6: no do-nothing fallback). Cooldown 2 rounds keeps it from trivializing one formation. Flat buy 14. Global contact check (R7). Combos with Apatite Hyphae's +3 harvest burst for a rock-focused build.

name: Apatite Dissolution
effect: One-shot (exhaust). Global: immediately gain +4 Phosphorus. Unplayable unless your network is in contact with a mineral/crystal formation.
flavor: A burst of oxalic acid etches apatite, liberating a slug of phosphate in a single pulse.
notes: Burst +4 P. Pays off the round played (no repay clock). Rock-contact gate keeps it a held card until you have routed there ('great card, save it until I reach the crystal'); unplayable otherwise (R6, no do-nothing fallback). Flat buy 14. Global (R7). Same total P as Polyphosphate Granule but as an instant burst gated on rock, vs Granule's spread-over-draws + deck depth -> distinct opportunity cost.

name: ATP Accelerant
effect: One-shot (exhaust). Global: draw 2 cards from your draw deck for free (do not pay the per-draw energy cost), produce +1 Phosphorus, then advance the round.
flavor: High-energy phosphate bonds fuel a surge of metabolic throughput, and spent phosphate is recovered into the pool.
notes: Gate 1 P, and it REFUNDS +1 P on play, so net resource cost is effectively 0 P while still reading as P-family. 2 free draws = ~16 energy saved for buy 14, net-positive whenever you have cards left -> a mid-game accelerant. Useless when card-dry (the clock still bites). Not an extender (draws EXISTING cards, no reshuffle, no NEW basics -> invariant 10 safe). Flat buy 14. Global (R7). No produce.energy so no double-tax flag despite the 1 P gate (it is an event, not an energy engine).

name: Septal Reinforcement
effect: One-shot (exhaust). Choose ONE installed NON-ENERGY engine from your tableau list: its per-round production is permanently increased by +1 of whatever it produces for the rest of the level. Cannot target an energy engine. Unplayable if you have no eligible engine installed.
flavor: Reinforced septal pores widen the cytoplasmic channels, letting a productive cord flow faster.
notes: KEEP (playtest like: ensure real opportunity cost). A permanent +1 production buff is ~+3.5 ev/round x remaining rounds, so the cost lives in TIMING + the 2 P gate, not the flat 14 buy. Played late it barely compounds, and it is UNPLAYABLE with no eligible engine installed (R6-style no-fallback) -> dead without a target and weak in the endgame -> strong but never auto-include. Explicitly bars energy engines (protects the engine-energy ceiling: never pushes one above +4/round). The choice is a GLOBAL pick among your own installed tableau engines (a list item, NOT a map node/strand/cell) -> R7-compliant: tableau cards are list items, not map cells. Flat buy 14.

name: Sclerotial Vault
effect: One-shot (exhaust). Directional: aim a compass direction. Discharge a dense rhizomorph cord that grows 8 cells through soil in that direction, ignoring growth time (does not pass through rock of any kind). Then global +1 Phosphorus.
flavor: A dense sclerotium discharges stored reserves into an explosive cord, punching a long survival cord through soil in one pulse.
notes: KEEP (playtest like). R8/R7/R3b compliant: a pure DIRECTIONAL growth-trick (R3b family) -> player aims a compass direction, the cord grows a fixed 8 cells through SOIL only, ignoring growth time -> a late-game spatial leap. growthAmount 8; player controls DIRECTION not distance (R3); NO 'toward the goal' auto-pathing (R8). Does NOT pierce rock (digging is the dig ladder's job, R6). The +1 P refund and the 2 P + 1 N gate keep it on-theme and non-spammable. Pays off instantly. Flat buy 14. 'Save it for the final push.'

name: Enzymatic Deep Bore
effect: One-shot (exhaust). Clears ONE whole rock: the nearest in-range BOULDER or rock FORMATION. Unplayable if no boulder or formation is in sensing range.
flavor: A secreted enzyme front softens a whole formation until it sloughs away in one sustained bore.
notes: Tier-2 dig (terrain ladder): clears BOULDER + FORMATION, one whole rock, no distance counting (R6). clears:['boulder','formation']. P-gated 2 (climbs the ladder's P gate 1->2->3->4 with tier). Targets the single nearest eligible in-range rock; unplayable if none in range (R6, no do-nothing fallback). Mid utility that opens the wide-low formations the family routes to for P harvests. Flat buy 14. No produce.energy.

name: Apatite Detonation
effect: One-shot (exhaust). Clears ONE whole rock: the nearest in-range rock FORMATION or ROCK-COLUMN (or, if only one eligible class is present, the nearest of that toward the goal). Then global +2 Phosphorus from the shattered mineral. Unplayable if no formation or column is in sensing range.
flavor: Stored phosphate reserves drive an explosive acid pulse that detonates a barrier and scatters phosphate-rich shards.
notes: Tier-3 dig (terrain ladder): clears FORMATION + ROCK-COLUMN, one whole rock, no distance counting (R6). clears:['formation','column']. P-gated 3 (heavy barrier-break; power in the gate, not the flat 14 buy). The classic 'dig UNDER the column' opener. Bonus +2 P on play ties it to the family identity (detonating apatite yields phosphate). Single-target directional-to-goal fallback allowed for the one rock (R8). Unplayable if no eligible rock in range (R6). Flat buy 14.

name: Glushinskite Bloom
effect: Install (gate: 1 Water to seed it). Global: each round, produce +1 Phosphorus. Each round it sits in contact with a mineral/crystal formation, it ALSO grows its biogenic crystal cast a little; after 3 such rounds it permanently produces +2 Phosphorus each round thereafter.
flavor: Where hyphae weather apatite they leave glushinskite, a magnesium-oxalate crystal that thickens into a self-reinforcing phosphate factory.
notes: A 'commitment' P engine that rewards parking on rock: +1/round, ramping to a permanent +2/round after 3 rounds of formation contact (flat numbers, R5). The 1 W seed-gate is a one-time PLAY gate (precious water spent to start a P engine) -> sequencing tension, and it is a RESOURCE engine so producing P does not conflict with the no-double-tax rule (that rule bars produce.ENERGY + a gate; this produces P, has no energy output, and is energy-ceiling EXEMPT). Repay ~4 (uncommon band) once ramped. Distinct from Mineral Foraging Hyphae (instant conditional +2 vs a permanent earned ramp) and from Apatite Hyphae (harvest bursts). Global; contact check is global (R7). Played late it never finishes the 3-round ramp -> a mid engine, not auto-include.

name: Phosphate Solubilizing Bloom
effect: One-shot (exhaust). Radius-around-a-tap (radius 60): every strand of YOUR network inside the radius is reinforced against the next threat that would eat or rot it (absorbs one hit each), and the same patch is cleansed of any current rot. P-gated 3.
flavor: A flood of solubilized phosphate stiffens cell walls into a brief armor and dissolves invading rot.
notes: The P-gated DEFENSE/STRUCTURE payoff the family direction calls for (P = structural reinforcement). RADIUS-around-a-tap (the canonical Amputate radius-60 primitive, R7/R9: never per-strand, never whole-map). Combines a one-hit shield + a local rot cleanse on the tapped patch. P-gated 3 (heavy, power in the gate not the flat 14 buy). One-shot event, no repay clock, no produce.energy (no double-tax). Differentiate from any future shield by RADIUS size. Strong in a threat-heavy push, dead-weight in a clean level -> state-dependent, never auto-include. Flat buy 14.

name: Constricting Ring
effect: Tap a point: lay constricting hyphal rings across all frontier strands within a small radius. The next nematode that enters the radius is snared and digested for +2 N, then the rings dissolve. If no worm enters within 3 rounds, the rings dissolve with no effect.
flavor: A three-celled ring inflates in a tenth of a second via turgor, throttling the passing nematode (Drechslerella brochopaga).
notes: R7: RADIUS-around-a-tap (small radius 40). Free deck-floor basic (buyCostEnergy 0). +2 N matches eat-a-worm yield. ACTIVE constriction trap (distinct from adhesive-glue lineage). Dud on a clean map, strong where worms roam = placement-dependent, never auto-include. Extenders can flood worm-heavy decks with these.

name: Mineralizing Saprobe
effect: Install a saprotrophic decay mat across your whole network. Each round, unconditionally gain +1 N from mineralizing ambient dead organic matter under the colony. Works on any map, worms or none.
flavor: Saprobes break down dead matter into ammonium, the colony's steady nitrogen baseline.
notes: The unconditional common +1 N/round producer so N-gated cards are never dead on worm-light levels. GLOBAL (whole network), no targeting tap. Resource engine = exempt from energy ceiling, produces NO energy. +1 N ~3.5 ev -> repay 4 (standard band). The reliable N spine; the ONLY pure-unconditional N engine in the family (Ammonifying Worm Bloom is worm-conditional, Nematophagous Mat has a worm-defense rider) so no duplicate non-decision at a pile. Not flashy, never auto-include because it competes with the conditional traps for the same N role.

name: Adhesive Web (A. oligospora)
effect: Install a sticky adhesive web over your whole frontier. Each round any nematode is within sight of the network, gain +1 N as grazers glue themselves and are colonized. On a worm-free round it scavenges trace decay for +1 N every OTHER worm-free round.
produces: 1 N / round while worms present; +1 N every other worm-free round
flavor: Hyphal loops coated in adhesive glycoprotein snare grazing nematodes (Arthrobotrys oligospora).
notes: PASSIVE adhesive-glue trap (distinct lineage from constricting rings) — naming teaches the two-strategy taxonomy. GLOBAL sight-based, no per-worm targeting (R7). Conditional resource engine: +1 N worm-active plus thin worm-free floor smooths a scouting misread -> repay 3 (light band). Produces NO energy, ceiling untouched. Pairs with scouting to confirm worms before buying. Distinct from Mineralizing Saprobe: higher worm-active ceiling but conditional.

name: Nematophagous Mat
effect: Install a dense predatory mat across the whole network. Each round gain a guaranteed +1 N from ambient decay scavenging, plus an extra +1 N (total +2 N, capped) on any round it caught a nematode. Every worm that touches the network that round is removed from the board. Feeds you on quiet maps and culls the swarm on rich ones.
produces: 1 N / round guaranteed, up to 2 N / round + global worm removal while worms present
flavor: A mature Arthrobotrys colony is a wall of traps; even worm-free it digests decaying matter, and a swarm becomes a self-thinning banquet.
notes: GLOBAL (whole network) worm removal, no per-strand targeting (R7). Guaranteed +1 N floor (with a worm-defense rider, so NOT a duplicate of pure-baseline Mineralizing Saprobe) doubles to +2 N + worm defense while worms roam, justifying rare over conditional Adhesive Web. Resource engine, produces NO energy, exempt from energy ceiling. Floor ~6 ev -> repay 5 (rare band).

name: Fungus-Garden Mat
effect: Install a cultivated decay garden across the whole network. Each round gain a guaranteed +1 Nitrogen from cultivated litter (works on any map, ants or none), plus an extra +1 N (total +2 N, capped) on any round it diverted an ant column. Every ant column that touches the network that round is turned back from the network and the piles adjacent to it. Feeds you on quiet maps and breaks the raid on ant-heavy ones.
produces: 1 N / round guaranteed, up to 2 N / round + turns back ant columns touching the network
flavor: The colony cultivates the very litter the ants raid for, thickening into a defensive garden mat that the raiding columns cannot cross.
notes: NEW (consolidation): the UNCONDITIONAL anti-ant defensive ENGINE the ant lane lacked, the direct parallel of Nematophagous Mat (worms). GLOBAL (whole network), no per-trail targeting (R7). Guaranteed +1 N floor (so NOT dead on ant-light maps, unlike Picket Hyphae / Trophallaxis Hijack which idle ant-free), doubling to +2 N + active ant turn-back while ants raid -> justifies rare over the conditional ant engines. Distinct from Picket Hyphae (which reduces pile-theft by 2 leaves) and Aphid Ranch (ant->ENERGY): this REMOVES ant pressure from the network + a resource floor. RESOURCE engine, produces NO energy, exempt from the energy ceiling; no W/P/N gate (no double-tax). Floor ~6 ev -> repay 5 (rare band).

name: Anastomosis Salvage
effect: One-shot. Recycle your own dead and rotted strands by fusing survivors: instantly gain +1 N for every 2 strands you have lost this level (rounded down, max +6 N). Exhaust.
flavor: Hyphae fuse at anastomosis points, scavenging nitrogen from the colony's own casualties.
notes: Instant N catch-up scaling with worm/mould damage — rewards a battered board, worthless on a pristine one. GLOBAL (counts whole-level losses), no targeting. Cap +6 prevents a blowout. One-shot event, repay 0. Lets a chewed-up player suddenly afford a gated power card.

name: Rhizomorph Cord
effect: One-shot. Spend 2 N to extrude an armored rhizomorph cord that clears the nearest eligible rock-column in sensing range (or the nearest eligible rock-column toward the goal) and lays fast strand through the cleared gap in a single action. Unplayable if no rock-column is in sensing range. Exhaust.
flavor: Rhizomorphs are armored hyphal cables that bore through soil to reach distant resources fast.
notes: R6/R8 FIXED: single unambiguous targeting clause matching the approved Hydraulic Boring phrasing (nearest eligible in range, OR nearest eligible toward the goal — the one sanctioned directional case). clears:[column] ONLY — the unique N-gated column-cracker; dropped FORMATION so it no longer overlaps the boulder+formation digs (R6 contiguous band of one class). UNPLAYABLE with no rock-column in range, no do-nothing fallback. No distance counting / cell digging. 2 N = standard gate; the family's 'spend nitrogen to win the race' card. Pays off the round played, repay 0.

name: GS-GOGAT Surge
effect: One-shot. Spend 3 N to fire the glutamine-synthetase/glutamate-synthase pathway: immediately add 6 Grow basics to your draw deck AND grow a large fan of strands from your whole frontier this round. A massive mid-run expansion. Exhaust.
flavor: Assimilated nitrogen floods the GS-GOGAT cycle into amino acids, exploding new hyphal mass.
notes: Named for the real fungal N-assimilation pathway. Gate 3 N (heavy tier) so it's castable by mid-game when N is hardest to amass. The marquee N-sink. Doubles as runway via the sanctioned extender path (adds NEW basics to the draw deck, card exhausts) per invariant 10. GLOBAL frontier growth, no node targeting (R7). Pays off instantly, repay 0.

name: Septal Plugging
effect: Installed action, once per 2 rounds. Tap a point: spend 1 N to plug septal pores across every strand within a medium radius, halting nematode feeding and mould rot spread inside that radius this round and the next, and reinforcing those strands against being eaten. Unplayable with no N.
flavor: Woronin bodies plug septal pores to wall off damaged compartments and stop infection spreading hypha to hypha.
notes: R7/R9: RADIUS-around-a-tap (medium radius 60, Amputate model), never per-strand or whole-map. Repeatable N-gated defense (action, cooldown 2). 1 N = light tier. Spends the resource worms give you = self-sustaining shield on worm-heavy boards. Action not engine -> repay 0. Dead if nothing is attacking = situational, not auto-include.

name: Hyphal Aggregation
effect: Installed action, once per round. Spend 1 N to aggregate hyphae into a cord initial: grow a short reinforced strand burst in a chosen direction from the frontier, denser and faster than a basic Grow. A steady N-to-growth converter you can fire whenever you have nitrogen.
flavor: Hyphae aggregate and align into a cord initial — pre-fruiting differentiation that drives directed growth.
notes: Cord initiation (not a 'hyphal knot' = fruiting beat, kept in fruiting family) keeps the developmental sequence clean. R7/R8: DIRECTIONAL player-aimed growth (growthAmount short burst), not single-cell targeting, not toward-goal. The reliable N spender; caps how much an N stockpile matters. Action cooldown 1, repay 0.

name: Fruiting Primordium
effect: One-shot, only usable once your network has reached the goal soil. Spend 1 N to force an early primordium: FRUIT and win the level immediately this round (a forced early primordium, even on near-empty energy), casting +2 spores that seed for next-level carry-over. Exhaust.
flavor: A true hyphal knot differentiates into a primordium ahead of season — protein-hungry fruit bodies pull on stored nitrogen.
notes: R5 FIXED: replaced the '1 to 2 rounds sooner' variable range with a single deterministic effect — fruit and win immediately this round. GLOBAL fruiting payoff (no targeting). Gate 1 N + the +2 spores so value clears price. Strictly LATE, gated on reaching goal = the canonical 'great card, save it'. Owns the 'hyphal knot -> primordium' developmental beat. One-shot, repay 0.

name: Aerial Spore Cast
effect: One-shot. Spend 2 N + 2 W to release an aerial spore cast: grow one independent new front in each of three chosen directions from the network edge this round, leaping gaps. Opens parallel routes around barriers toward unvisited piles. Exhaust.
flavor: A fruiting flush casts spores on air currents that germinate elsewhere — the colony leaps gaps it cannot bridge by growth.
notes: DATA FIX: playCostWater set to 2 to match the '2 N + 2 W' effect text (was w:0 mismatch). R7/R8: DIRECTIONAL, three player-chosen directions from the network edge, no cell/node ids. Mixed gate 2 N + 2 W is the intended heavy-tier gate for a rare late payoff (power lives in the gate). Late multi-front swing: useless early, brilliant when a barrier has stalled you = opportunity-cost decision.

name: Ammonifying Worm Bloom
effect: Install an ammonifying culture over the whole network. Each round at least one nematode is in sight, gain +1 N AND convert worm decay into a reinforcing pulse that repairs light feeding damage network-wide. Worm-free rounds it lies dormant (no N).
produces: 1 N / round while worms present (+ network repair)
flavor: Decomposing nematode tissue is ammonified back into the colony, turning the swarm into fuel and patch material.
notes: Explicit worm->resource loop engine that also defends via global repair, distinct from the pure traps. GLOBAL sight-based, no per-worm targeting (R7). Conditional resource engine, produces NO energy, exempt from ceiling. +1 N + repair ~3.5-4 ev -> repay 4 (standard band). Strictly conditional on worms (no unconditional floor — distinct from Mineralizing Saprobe and Nematophagous Mat) so it competes with Adhesive Web for the worm slot = real draft choice, not auto-include.

name: Nutrient Transmutation
effect: Installed action, once per round. Convert resources at a loss across the network: spend 2 of any one stored resource (W, P, or N) to gain 1 of any other (W, P, or N). Unplayable without 2 of a resource to spend.
flavor: The colony reroutes its metabolism, trading one assimilated nutrient pool for another it needs more.
notes: The generic W<->P<->N converter at a loss (2->1) so a card gated on a map-absent resource is never fully dead. GLOBAL on stockpiles, no targeting. Lives in the nitrogen family as its N-routing utility. Action cooldown 1, repay 0. 2->1 loss keeps hoarding weak (soft cap 6 still bites) so it's a relief valve, not an engine. Situational = not auto-include.

name: Vesicle Supply Line
effect: Add 5 Apical Drive basics to your draw deck, then exhaust this card to the graveyard. Extends your runway of forward steps against deck depletion.
flavor: A sustained stream of secretory vesicles is ferried up the cord to the tip, feeding continuous extension.
notes: R2 flat buy 14. EXTENDER: adds NEW basics then graveyard (invariant 10: only extenders add new basics). Strong EARLY, a trap LATE. The family's runway card. targeting global.

name: Chemotropic Sensing
effect: Once per 2 rounds: reveal all food piles, lakes, mineral formations, and nematode swarms within a wide radius of your frontier. Revealed attractors become valid targets for attractor-seeking growth. Install (repeatable on cooldown).
flavor: Hyphae steer up gradients of sugars and amino acids - true fungal chemotaxis along the Spitzenkorper.
notes: R2 buy 14. Installed ACTION, repay 0 (not an engine). R8: pure REVEAL, no auto-routing. Value = information; strongest EARLY, weak LATE. Cooldown 2. targeting global (radius reveal). Feeds Tropic growth & Spore Dispersal Vector.

name: Cord Formation
effect: PERSISTENT: on each round in which you also drew or played a card, advance your frontier one extra growth step in your most-recently-aimed direction for free. Dissolves after it has granted 8 free steps. Does NOT trigger on idle/SKIP/card-dry rounds.
produces: +1 free growth step on active rounds (~6-7 energy-equiv of saved draws), capped at 8 total then dissolves
flavor: Rhizomorphs - bundled, insulated hyphal cords - are the fungus's highways for fast long-distance transport, but cords senesce once laid.
notes: R2 buy 14, repay 2 (common band 2-3). R8: 'most-recently-aimed direction' (no goal-pathing). Self-limiting front-loaded GROWTH engine: active-rounds-only clause protects the idle-bleed clock; 8-step cap = the 'too late' trap. Growth not energy => EXEMPT from energy ceiling. EARLY engine. targeting directional growthAmount=1.

name: Thigmotropic Steering
effect: Once per 3 rounds: instantly re-aim your ENTIRE frontier to a player-chosen compass direction, abandoning a dead-end heading without growing. Pure re-orientation; the next growth follows the new aim.
flavor: Hyphae read surface topology by contact - thigmotropism - feeling along ridges and pores to thread the gaps around obstacles.
notes: R2 buy 14. R8: player-AIMED directional re-orientation, no pathfinding. Installed ACTION, repay 0, cooldown 3. Invaluable MID when grown into a dead end. targeting directional (re-aim, growthAmount=0).

name: Acidic Exudate
effect: PERSISTENT: each round, clear the SINGLE nearest in-range BOULDER or FORMATION rock by acid-etching, opening it for growth next round. UNPLAYABLE if no boulder or formation is in sensing range. Cannot touch rock columns or lake basins.
produces: +1 cleared boulder/formation per round it has a target (~3-4 energy-equiv of avoided detour)
flavor: Hyphae secrete oxalic and citric acid to dissolve mineral substrates and bore into stone.
notes: R2 buy 14, repay 4. R6: TIER-2 dig ENGINE, clears=[boulder,formation], whole-rock per round, UNPLAYABLE on open maps. R5: flat +1 rock/round. 1 PHOSPHORUS gate (tier-2 P-ladder). GROWTH/routing engine, no produce.energy => EXEMPT from energy ceiling; not double-taxed. clears boulder,formation. targeting directional.

name: Tap-Root Rhizomorph
effect: PERSISTENT: each round, clear the SINGLE nearest in-range FORMATION or ROCK-COLUMN, driving a deep cord through it (the only engine that cracks a column). UNPLAYABLE if no formation or column is in sensing range.
produces: +1 cleared formation/column per round it has a target (~5 energy-equiv of barrier bypass)
flavor: A dominant downward cord - the fungal analogue of a tap-root - probes deep to undermine and crack obstacles.
notes: R2 buy 14, repay 4 (uncommon band 4-5). R6: TIER-3 dig ENGINE, clears=[formation,column], whole-rock per round. UNPLAYABLE with no eligible rock in range. 2 PHOSPHORUS gate (tier-3 P-ladder). GROWTH/routing engine, no produce.energy => EXEMPT from energy ceiling. clears formation,column. targeting directional.

name: Predatory Rhizomorph
effect: PERSISTENT: each round advance the frontier one extra growth step in your most-recently-aimed direction AND, if any nematode lies within a short radius of the frontier, snare and digest one - clearing it and gaining +2 NITROGEN (at most one worm per round). Each worm cleared permanently adds +1 to this engine's growth steps, to a maximum of +3 bonus (cap +4 total).
produces: +1 growth step/round, scaling to +4 max as worms are cleared; +2 N per worm (max once/round)
flavor: A foraging predatory cord strangles nematodes with adhesive snare loops, each kill fuelling further advance.
notes: R2 buy 14, repay 5 (rare band 4-6). R8: 'most-recently-aimed direction'. R7: worm-snare is RADIUS-around-frontier. R5: flat +1 steps, +2 N, hard cap +3 bonus, N capped once/round. 2 NITROGEN gate (eat worms first). GROWTH+resource engine, no produce.energy => EXEMPT from energy ceiling. MID. targeting directional/radius. clears none (worms, not rock).

name: Positive Phototropism
effect: ONE-SHOT: once the sunlit goal surface is revealed and in range, bend every tip sharply toward the light and surge the whole frontier 3 steps up the final stretch toward the goal, readying them to FRUIT. UNPLAYABLE until the goal is revealed and in range. Exhaust.
flavor: At the surface a fruiting body bends toward sunlight - positive phototropism - lifting its spore-bearing tip into the open air.
notes: R2 buy 14. LATE finisher. R8: 'toward the goal' allowed - the goal is the revealed SURFACE attractor in range, a one-shot directional surge, not perpetual homing. UNPLAYABLE until goal revealed. 1 WATER gate (turgor). Pays the round played (repay 0). targeting directional growthAmount=3.

name: Spore Dispersal Vector
effect: ONE-SHOT: launch a spore toward a chosen REVEALED attractor (a scouted food pile, lake, formation, or the goal soil) and germinate a NEW independent frontier tip there, leapfrogging all terrain between. The new tip grows like your main one. UNPLAYABLE if no attractor has been revealed. Exhaust.
flavor: Aerial spores let a colony skip hostile ground and colonise a distant niche outright.
notes: R2 buy 14. RARE EVENT, plays for 1 NITROGEN, pays the round played (repay 0). R7/R8: targets a REVEALED ATTRACTOR (not a raw cell id, not blind goal-pathing) - directional-to-attractor. UNPLAYABLE if nothing revealed (synergy with Chemotropic Sensing). The ultimate routing skip, a planned LATE swing. targeting directional. clears none.

name: Chemorepellent Trail
effect: Once per 3 rounds: tap a point to mark every food pile within a small radius (45) as repellent. Ants entering those piles this round and next forfeit their harvest there (you keep the full pile if you reach it). Does not affect ants already on a pile.
flavor: Volatile oxylipins broadcast through the hyphae warn off foraging ants by chemotaxis.
notes: Action install, 3-round cooldown, 1W per use (one harvest detour). R7: retargeted from 'one adjacent pile' to RADIUS-around-a-tap (radius 45, small in the radius family). Value = protecting a contested pile's ~40 energy + draft from partial ant loss; opportunity cost is the water and the cooldown. Not auto-include: dead if no contested pile is in reach. Targeting=radius. repayRounds 0 (not an engine).

name: Formic Vanguard
effect: One-shot: tap a point to collapse every ant nest within a medium radius (90). Permanently stops new ant spawns from those nests and clears their trails. Unplayable if no nest is inside the radius. Exhaust.
flavor: Enzymatic siege of the colony brood chamber halts the raiding line at its source.
notes: Big tempo swing; 2N gate forces you to have fought/decayed first. R7: retargeted from 'within 2 tiles' to RADIUS-around-a-tap (radius 90). Unplayable (greyed out) if no nest in the radius — no do-nothing fallback. Late it can be too slow (nest already bled you) -> timing tension. Targeting=radius. One-shot event, repay 0.

name: Trophallaxis Hijack
effect: Install. Each round, globally tap the ant foraging trails crossing your network. On any round an ant trail crosses your strands, skim 1 carried food load and route it into your colony as nutrient (not master energy): +1 to your network colonize/nutrient trickle that round. Idles on rounds when no ant trail crosses you.
produces: defense + nutrient (skims 1 ant food load/round into colony nutrient trickle, NOT master energy; produce.energy = 0)
flavor: The colony taps the ants' mouth-to-mouth food sharing, siphoning a cut of every relay that passes through its threads.
notes: NEW anti-ant ENGINE (ants previously had no engine). Reviewer fix (invariant 3): does NOT print master energy — it redirects an ant food load into the per-cell colonize/nutrient trickle, so produce.energy===0 and it is ENERGY-CEILING EXEMPT (no double-tax with its 1N trigger-seed). The ant-trail condition is a TRIGGER, not a resource gate. Buy 14, repay 4 (uncommon band 4-5; ~3.5 ev/round of nutrient value, +1N seed -> ~22/3.5 ~= 4.5). 1N gate is proportionate (produces nutrient/defense, not energy). Targeting=global. Trap if ants never trail across you -> idles. Wants EARLY install to ride the whole ant cycle.

name: Melanized Sheath
effect: Install. Each round, melanize the 3 strands nearest any Trichoderma cloud: they cannot be infected and block cloud spread through them (melanized strands persist). Idles on rounds with no cloud near your network.
produces: defense (melanizes 3 strands/round nearest a cloud; blocks infection + cloud spread)
flavor: Melanin-impregnated walls resist enzymatic attack and oxidative assault from Trichoderma.
notes: Early defensive engine. Reviewer R5 fix: replaced 'a growing share of your occupied strands' with the FLAT count '3 strands nearest any cloud per round' (flat, no proportion). R7: GLOBAL auto-selection (3 nearest a cloud — no per-strand player targeting). Buy 14, repay 3 (common band 2-3; ~5 ev/round in avoided rot on the flat-14 buy). Ungated (commons carry no resource gate; no double-tax). Energy-ceiling exempt (produces defense, produce.energy 0). Targeting=global. Trap if bought with no mould near OR too late to harden before clouds arrive. Great pre-emptive on mould-heavy maps, dead on ant-only maps.

name: Mycoparasitic Reversal
effect: Install. Each round, globally clear up to 3 infected strand cells from your network and convert the rotted biomass into +1 N. Idles on rounds with no infection present.
produces: defense + nitrogen (clears up to 3 infected cells/round, +1 N/round while infection present)
flavor: The colony turns the tables on its mycoparasite, eating the eater and banking the spoils as nitrogen.
notes: NEW mould->N conversion ENGINE (per family direction). Reviewer R5 fix: 'digest a share of the infection' replaced with FLAT 'clear up to 3 infected strand cells each round'. Defense that FEEDS the N economy from the mould threat, the anti-mould twin of Arthrobotrys Snare. Buy 14, repay 4 (uncommon band; cleared rot ~3 ev + 1N harvest ~3.5 ev, but only while infection present -> effective ~4). Ungated (the income IS resource; gating N-in would double-tax). Energy-ceiling exempt (produces defense+resource, produce.energy 0). Targeting=global. Trap on a mould-free map -> pure idle. Self-funding loop on a creeping-infection level.

name: Antibiosis Bloom
effect: One-shot: tap a point to emit an antibiotic burst, dissolving all Trichoderma clouds within a medium radius (90) and clearing infection from strands inside it. Unplayable if no cloud or infection is inside the radius. Exhaust.
flavor: A counter-offensive of antifungal metabolites against Trichoderma, itself a notorious mycoparasite that normally hunts other fungi.
notes: Cheap reactive panic button, 1N gate. R7: 'within 2 tiles' -> RADIUS-around-a-tap (radius 90). Unplayable if nothing to clear in the radius (no do-nothing fallback). ANY timing — value is purely opportunity-based (how much cloud is actually on you). Not auto-include: wasted on a single distant cloud. Targeting=radius. No engine, repay 0.

name: Hydrophobin Cleanse
effect: Once per 2 rounds: tap a point to scrub infection off all strands within a large radius (120), coat them water-repellent (immune to re-infection for 2 rounds), and repair rot damage inside the radius. Unplayable if no infection is inside the radius.
flavor: Hydrophobin films sheet over hyphae, shedding spores and sealing wounds.
notes: Repeatable cleanse, 2-round cooldown, 2W gate per use. R7: 'up to 3 strand segments' -> RADIUS-around-a-tap (radius 120, the LARGE end of the radius family vs Antibiosis 90 / Chemorepellent 45). Unplayable if no infection in radius. Strong sustained answer to a spreading front; opportunity cost is repeated water harvests. Dead if no recurring infection. Targeting=radius. Action, repay 0.

name: Arthrobotrys Snare
effect: Install. Each round, set constricting loops network-wide. A nematode crossing any looped strand is trapped (stops eating) and digested next round for +2 N. Idles on rounds with no nematode crossing.
produces: defense + nitrogen (traps worms, +2N on a catch)
flavor: Arthrobotrys throws three-celled rings that snap shut on a passing nematode.
notes: Cross-refs N economy: defense that FEEDS your N stockpile. R7: 'one segment' -> GLOBAL network-wide loops. Buy 14, repay 3 (common band). 1N to seed (priming the trap) kept because it produces N back -> self-funding loop, not double-tax. Energy-ceiling exempt (defense+resource, produce.energy 0). Targeting=global. Trap if no nematodes present -> idles. Not auto-include.

name: Adhesive Net
effect: Once per 2 rounds: tap a point to lay a sticky net over a small radius (45). Nematodes inside are immobilized for 1 round and cannot eat or multiply while stuck. Unplayable if no nematode is inside the radius.
flavor: Adhesive knobs and nets of Arthrobotrys oligospora glue worms in place.
notes: Cheap crowd-control, 2-round cooldown, 1W gate. R7: '2x2 area' -> RADIUS-around-a-tap (radius 45, small). Unplayable if no worm in radius. ANY timing — stalls a swarm so you route past or out-grow it. Value scales with swarm density; weak on a lone worm. Targeting=radius. Action, repay 0.

name: Chitinase Surge
effect: One-shot: tap a point to digest every nematode within a large radius (120) instantly. Gain +2 N per worm killed. Unplayable if no nematode is inside the radius. Exhaust.
flavor: A flood of chitin-cleaving enzymes liquefies the worm cuticle en masse.
notes: Swarm-clear PAYOFF that can REFUND its own 3N gate against a big swarm. R7: 'within 3 tiles' -> RADIUS-around-a-tap (radius 120, large). Unplayable if no worm in radius. Net-positive N only when 2+ worms die. Dead/expensive vs few worms -> target tension. Targeting=radius. One-shot, repay 0.

name: Sclerotial Bunker
effect: Install. Each round, globally fortify the 3 strands nearest the most threats: they become sclerotial — immune to ants, mould, and worms — and regenerate 1 adjacent damaged strand. Sclerotial strands persist.
flavor: Dense sclerotia — hardened survival bodies — wall off the colony's core against all comers.
notes: Rare all-threat engine. Reviewer R5 fix: replaced 'a share of strands' and undefined 'fortify rate' with FLAT 'fortify the 3 strands nearest the most threats each round + regenerate 1 adjacent damaged strand'. R7: GLOBAL auto-selection (no node targeting). Flat buy 14 (was 28). 2P gate forces mineral routing; the rare power lives in the gate + all-threat coverage, not price. ~6 ev/round (prevented tax + repair) -> repay 5 (rare band 4-6). Energy-ceiling exempt (produces defense, produce.energy 0). Targeting=global. Trap if played late (r13+) -> can't repay; trap on single-threat maps where a cheap targeted card is better. Flagship on chaotic mixed-threat levels.

name: Anastomosis Weave
effect: Install. Each round, fuse strands network-wide into redundant loops. Damaged or eaten strands reroute through the mesh instead of severing your route to the goal. Idles on rounds with no damage to reroute.
flavor: Hyphal anastomosis knits the colony into a fault-tolerant mesh.
notes: All-threat resilience engine. R7: 'two nearby strands' -> GLOBAL network-wide fusing (no strand selection). Buy 14, single 1N gate (proportionate; not double-tax, produces no energy). ~3.5 ev/round (avoided re-grow tempo) -> repay 4 (uncommon band 4-5). Energy-ceiling exempt (produce.energy 0). Targeting=global. Wants EARLY play to build the mesh before damage; a trap late. Not auto-include: idles on a clean fast route with little threat contact.

name: Spore Bastion
effect: One-shot: emit a colony-wide spore cloud. For the next 3 rounds ALL threats (ants, mould, nematodes) are halted across the whole map — no advancing, infecting, eating, or harvesting against you. Exhaust.
flavor: A synchronized sporulation pulse blankets the substrate, stalling every antagonist.
notes: Late-game PAYOFF: buys 3 clean rounds to make the final dig and fruit. Flat buy 14 (was 28); rare power is in the mixed 2W+2N gate, not price. GLOBAL by nature (colony-wide, no tap) — the legitimate global payoff case, not a targeting dodge. Worthless early (nothing to protect, wastes the window); shines as the closer when decks are dry and threats swarm the goal. Targeting=global. One-shot, repay 0.

name: Hydrophobin Rind
effect: While installed, the FIRST threat tax you would pay each round (ant detour, mould rot, or nematode strand-loss) is reduced by 4 energy, to a minimum of 0. If no threat taxes you that round, it does nothing.
produces: damage mitigation (up to 4 energy/round, only on taxed rounds)
flavor: Hydrophobin proteins coat hyphae in a water-repellent rind that shrugs off insult and desiccation.
notes: KEEP. R11: removed the 'does not stack with itself / with Melanized Cord' clause (every card is one unique copy; the two cards simply mitigate different threat sets and can co-exist). GLOBAL targeting (network-wide passive). ENGINE-CEILING SAFE: produces NO energy -- it only cancels losses, capped at 4 and only when a threat actually taxes; exempt from the energy sum (not a printer). In a quiet stretch it pays nothing, so it cannot help an idle player break even. Repay 4 = uncommon band under sustained pressure. Tension: brilliant on a contested mid-map gauntlet, dead on a quiet route -- read the map. W-gate fits the desiccation/turgor theme.

name: Melanized Cord
effect: While installed, the FIRST nematode or mould threat tax you would pay each round (strand-loss or rot) is reduced by 3 energy, to a minimum of 0. Ant detours are not covered. If no worm or mould taxes you that round, it does nothing.
produces: damage mitigation (up to 3 energy/round, worm/mould rounds only)
flavor: Melanin-blackened rhizomorph cords are tough, stress-hardened cables that resist rot and worm-grazing.
notes: KEEP. R11: removed all 'does not stack' clauses; it no longer touches SKIP cost at all (old -3 SKIP effect deleted -- it broke the engine ceiling). GLOBAL targeting. The cheaper, narrower cousin of Hydrophobin Rind: 3 vs 4, worms+mould only vs all-three. ENGINE-CEILING SAFE: produces NO energy, never touches SKIP, exempt from the energy sum. Repay 3 = common band (~3 taxed rounds to recoup). Tension: cheap insurance for a worm/mould-heavy route, dead on a quiet one; overlaps Rind if you run both, so rarely want both. N-gate fits melanization-under-stress.

name: Primordium Set
effect: While installed, every 3rd round (a built-in cooldown) it banks +2 spores toward your final fruiting yield. The spores persist; the longer it stays installed before you fruit, the more it banks.
produces: spores (+2 every 3 rounds toward final yield)
flavor: Primordia are the tiny pinhead knots that commit to becoming mushrooms days before they swell.
notes: REWORKED for R7: old version laid a marker 'at your current growth front' = single-node targeting, illegal on phone. Now a GLOBAL slow-tick spore engine on a 3-round internal cooldown -- no tap, no node selection. Re-typed action->engine (it now produces each cooldown window) with repay 5 = uncommon band (measured in spores: ~6 rounds to net real value vs a Spore Print Flush). ENGINE-CEILING EXEMPT: produces SPORES (win-score), never energy. The 'great if I'd bought it sooner' tension: install early for several ticks, install late for one or none = a trap. W-gate keeps it off auto-include.

name: Stipe Buttress
effect: While installed, +1 spore is banked toward your final fruiting yield each round. The spores persist; the count keeps rising every round it stays installed.
flavor: The stipe buttresses the cap, channeling resources upward so spores accumulate as the fruiting body matures.
notes: KEEP. GLOBAL targeting. ENGINE-CEILING EXEMPT: produces SPORES (win-score), never energy, so exempt from the <11 sum but still carries a repay clock.
