Repay 5 = uncommon band, measured in spores (~5+ rounds to beat two Spore Print Flushes for the buy). The signature 'too late to bother' engine: install r6 nets ~10 spores, install r14 nets ~3. Faster but capped-by-cooldown sibling Primordium Set vs this steady-drip version -- distinct curves. P-gate (structural theme) + long clock prevent auto-include.

name: Spore Print Flush
effect: Exhaust. Bank +3 spores toward your final fruiting yield (banked immediately, persists to the fruit). Playable any time.
flavor: A mature cap drops a dense spore print -- a single heavy release of millions of propagules.
notes: KEEP. GLOBAL targeting, one-shot, repay 0, banks instantly = playable any time. The floor payoff card: small, reliable spores for a small W cost. NOT auto-include -- the W could gate a stronger play, and the spores are flat; Primordium Set / Stipe Buttress / Synchronous Flush out-scale it given runway. The opportunity-cost-only card of the family.

name: Synchronous Flush
effect: Exhaust, playable only while any part of your network is inside the GOAL zone. Your fruiting yield this level is DOUBLED, but the level ends immediately this round (you fruit now, forfeiting any further routing).
flavor: A synchronized flush sends up every primordium at once, doubling the spore print before the network spends itself.
notes: KEEP. R7-compliant: 'network inside the GOAL zone' is a GLOBAL state check, not a node tap. One-shot payoff, repay 0, pays the instant it resolves = legal LATE play. The in-goal-only restriction + forfeiting further routing keeps it a planned endgame swing: buy only if you reach the goal with spores worth doubling. Doubling spores never touches the energy economy. NOTE: doubling is a multiplier on a count, not a percentage of energy -- R5-safe (the spore total stays an integer).

name: Shade-or-Sun Cap
effect: Exhaust. Choose ONE: SUN -- gain +18 energy now (a fast cash payout); or SHADE -- bank +6 spores toward your final fruiting yield. You cannot choose both.
flavor: Caps grown in sun bolt for quick spore release and shrivel; caps grown in shade swell slow and seed heavily.
notes: CONSOLIDATION re-cost (SUN was +28, an auto-include cash spike): dropped to +18 so SUN no longer rivals a pile and the FORK stays the point. GLOBAL targeting, one-shot, repay 0, pays instantly = playable any time. ENGINE-CEILING SAFE: SUN is a flat one-shot refund, never per-round income. The decision is the FORK: SUN rescues a cash-starved mid-run, SHADE is the bigger spore haul if already solvent and goal-bound. Never strictly dominated; value flips with energy state. W-gate.

name: Anastomosis Graft
effect: Install (pay 1 Nitrogen + 1 Phosphorus now, whether or not it ever fires). While installed, the first time your energy would hit 0 this level, instead set energy to 20 and discard this card. If you reach the goal without triggering it, the committed resources are simply spent.
flavor: Anastomosis fuses separate hyphae into one network, sharing resources so a starved tip is rescued by its neighbors.
notes: REVISED per reviewer (medium): old 3 N up-front gate single-locked to the scarcest currency on ant-only / worm-light maps, making this a frequent conditional dud. Re-gated to a MIXED 1 N + 1 P split so it is not locked to one scarce resource (P harvests off any mineral formation/boulder, decoupling it from worm supply) while keeping a meaningful 2-resource commitment for a one-time life-save that may never fire. GLOBAL targeting (triggers on a global energy=0 condition, no tap). ENGINE-CEILING SAFE: the +20 fires once at 0 energy, never per-round, so it cannot reverse idle bleed or interact with the energy sum (one-shot rescue, not a printer -- exempt from the <11 sum). No double-tax: produces no energy, so a W/P/N gate is legal. repay 0 since it is insurance, not value/round. Committed 1N+1P fire-or-not = 'did I waste resources that could have played a swing?' tension, not a free parachute. NOT auto-include: pure waste if you'd have lived anyway. Late clutch-crossing buy.

name: Sclerotial Bloom
effect: Exhaust. Clears ONE whole rock -- the nearest eligible FORMATION or ROCK-COLUMN in sensing range (or, if a rock of those classes lies toward the goal, that one) -- in a single explosive germination, AND banks +2 spores toward your final yield. Unplayable if no formation or rock-column is in range.
produces: spores (+2 to final yield) + one whole-rock clear
flavor: Sclerotia germinate explosively after dormancy, throwing out a fast rhizomorph and a flush of pins at once.
notes: REWORKED for R6/R8: old version 'extend a long deep tunnel toward the goal (one-shot major dig)' was free-form distance growth toward the goal = illegal. Now a Tier-3 DIG on the terrain ladder (clears FORMATION + ROCK-COLUMN, one whole rock, no distance counting), using the one approved directional exception ('nearest eligible rock toward the goal'), plus the +2 spore bonus -- preserving the 'close the gap' identity legally. R6: UNPLAYABLE if no eligible rock in range (no do-nothing fallback). Gate re-themed to pure P (phosphorus = barrier-break, Tier-3 = 3 P), dropping the old 2W+1P+1N mixed gate. One-shot, repay 0. NOT auto-include: heavy 3 P + needs a formation/column in your path; dead near an open goal.

name: Veil Rupture
effect: Exhaust. Bank +1 spore toward your final yield for each nematode currently alive on the map (count them now), to a minimum of +1. Playable any time.
flavor: The partial veil tears as the cap expands -- on a worm-rich substrate the flush comes in heavy.
notes: NEW. Fills a family gap: a payoff card that reads the THREAT state (turns the worm threat into spore upside, paying the family's 'threats tax you' theme). GLOBAL targeting -- counts all live nematodes, no tap, no per-strand targeting (R7). R5: flat +1 per worm, integer count, no percentages. One-shot, repay 0, banks instantly. ENGINE-CEILING SAFE: spores only, never energy. NOT auto-include: scales to 0-ish on a worm-light map (min +1 keeps it from being a literal dead card, the converter-gap principle), big on a worm-heavy one -- value flips with the map. N-gate (you metabolize the worms into the flush).

name: Stroma Crust
effect: While installed, +1 spore is banked toward your final yield each round, BUT each round it is installed you also pay 1 extra energy of upkeep (a risk/reward downside). The spores persist; you may discard this card at end of any round to stop the upkeep.
flavor: A stroma crust knits a dense mat that feeds the developing fruit -- but the mat is hungry while it builds.
notes: NEW. The family's risk/reward downside-tempo card (framework asks for a couple). An UNGATED (0 W/P/N) early spore engine -- so it is always playable -- but it bleeds 1 energy/round upkeep, the cost living in tempo not in a resource gate. ENGINE-CEILING SAFE: produces SPORES not energy; the upkeep makes idle play strictly worse, never better, so it cannot break the energy sum. Repay 2 = common band IF you install early and run it many rounds; install it late or in a tight energy spot and the upkeep eats you = real 'is the runway worth it?' tension. Discardable to staunch the bleed = an out, not a trap. Distinct from Stipe Buttress (P-gated, no upkeep): this trades a gate for a clock.

name: Hardened Apothecium
effect: While installed, +1 spore is banked toward your final yield each round; AND on any round in which a threat taxes you, it banks +1 additional spore (you metabolize the insult into growth). The spores persist.
flavor: The apothecium hardens against grazing; stress only drives it to seed harder.
notes: NEW. A heavy payoff engine that bridges the family's payoff and survival halves: pays steady spores AND rewards crossing a contested route (the more the map taxes you, the more it seeds). GLOBAL targeting; reads global threat-tax state, no tap. R5: flat +1 / +2, integer. ENGINE-CEILING EXEMPT: spores only, never energy -- so the W+P gate is NOT a double-tax (rule applies only to energy engines; this prints no energy). Repay 4 = rare band justified by the threatened-round spike. NOT auto-include: 1W+1P split gate demands you routed to both a lake and minerals; flat +1 floor is mediocre on a quiet route where the bonus never fires.

name: Hyphal Tip Extension
effect: Add 3 Grow basics to your draw deck, then this card goes to the discard.
flavor: Apical extension: hyphae elongate only at their growing tips, feeding fresh segments forward into new soil.
notes: Smallest runway extender (runway family is 3 / 4 / 6 basics). +3 basics buys ~3 future rounds of draw fuel against deck depletion. Early read: cheap insurance against running dry while you still have piles to refill draw energy. Late read: dead weight, no rounds left to cash the basics. Adds NEW basics, not recycled (depletion stays the clock). No play cost; you paid the flat-14 buy. Sits below Mycelial Fan-Out on raw count but is the affordable-anywhere option, so neither dominates.

name: Mycelial Fan-Out
effect: Add 6 basics of your choice of split between Grow and Add-Substrate to your draw deck, then this card goes to the discard.
flavor: A foraging front fans into a search mycelium, throwing many parallel cords across open substrate at once.
notes: Largest runway extender: 6 basics is the mid-game metronome backbone for ~12-16 round levels. Buy at a pile mid-run when you can SEE depletion coming. Too early floods your deck before you have piles to refill draw energy; too late you cannot cash the basics. Same flat-14 buy as Hyphal Tip Extension, so the choice is timing/deck-state, not price. Not an engine (no per-round produce). Adds NEW basics; not recycled. Removed prior 16-energy tier per flat-buy lock.

name: Mineral Forage Front
effect: Add 3 Phosphorus-Tap basics to your draw deck, then this card goes to the discard. (Each Phosphorus-Tap basic, when drawn and played, taps the nearest in-range mineral formation or boulder for +3 Phosphorus, or is a dead draw if none is in range.)
flavor: The colony commits cords toward the mineral seams, pre-loading the deck with prospecting tips.
notes: P-harvest extender, half of the W/P/N basic-extender parity set (Decay Forage Front covers N; Water harvest stays the scarce one-lake baseline). Seeds NEW basic P-taps so a P-gated build keeps phosphorus flowing past the premium drafts. Each tap is GLOBAL nearest-target resolve on the nearest in-range mineral (R7: no cell/node id; same auto-nearest model as resource harvest), and is a dead draw with no formation in range, so it is map-state-dependent, never auto-include. Adds NEW basics; not recycled. Repay 0 (not an engine).

name: Decay Forage Front
effect: Add 3 Decay-Tap basics to your draw deck, then this card goes to the discard. (Each Decay-Tap basic, when drawn and played, converts the nearest in-range nematode or rotted patch for +2 Nitrogen, or is a dead draw if none is in range.)
flavor: Scavenger cords pre-deploy toward the worm-churned soil, ready to digest the colony's attackers into fuel.
notes: NEW N-basic extender completing W/P/N basic parity (pairs with Mineral Forage Front). Seeds NEW basic Decay-Taps that turn the worm threat into Nitrogen (+2 per nematode/rot, matching the harvest table). GLOBAL nearest-target resolve (R7: no node id), dead draw when nothing eligible is in range, so it shines on worm/mould-heavy maps and idles on clean ones, never auto-include. Adds NEW basics; not recycled. Repay 0 (not an engine). threat:worm because it feeds on the worm/decay economy.

name: Septal Pore Gating
effect: Install. The first card you DRAW each round costs 3 less energy (draw 8 becomes 5). Limited to the first draw of each round.
flavor: Septal pores with Woronin-body plugs meter flow between cells, opening just enough to let cytoplasm slip through cheaply.
notes: DRAW-DISCOUNT engine. It saves energy on a draw rather than printing energy, so produce.energy is 0: NOT an energy engine, does NOT count toward the +11 engine ceiling, and is never net income while card-dry (a discount needs a draw to exist, so it can never break the idle-negative invariant). Repay = 14 / ~3 savings-per-round = ~5 rounds, standard band. Early-only value: late game has few draws left to discount. No W/P/N gate (no double-tax). Dropped the old no-stack clause (R11) and the lower 8 tier (flat-14).

name: Chemotactic Foray
effect: One-shot: draw 2 cards from your draw deck for free (ignore draw cost), then exhaust this card.
flavor: Chemotaxis: hyphae sense a nutrient gradient and rush two foraging fronts toward the richest patch at once.
notes: Free 2-card draw burst: saves ~16 energy of draw cost for a flat-14 buy, a small net-positive access spike, not an engine. Opportunity cost is that it empties your draw deck FASTER, pulling depletion forward, so it is a trap if it cards-you-out before the endgame push. Sits below the Water-gated Anastomosis Bridge, which draws the same 2 but adds Scry-5 selection, so neither dominates. Exhausts; not recycled. Repay 0.

name: Anastomosis Bridge
effect: One-shot: look at the top 5 cards of your draw deck, draw 2 of them for free, leave the rest on top in any order. Then exhaust.
flavor: Anastomosis: two hyphae fuse where they touch, splicing the network so resources reroute and the colony shares one fate.
notes: Selective draw plus deck sculpting (Scry 5, take 2, reorder the rest). Gated by 1 Water (the scarce resource) so it is NOT a strict upgrade over the free-buy Chemotactic Foray: it needs a lake detour, which is the opportunity cost. Same flat-14 buy as Foray; the Water gate is the differentiator, not price. Smooths variance and sets up next round while only removing 2 cards from the deck. Weak on a thin deck (little to scry). Exhausts; not recycled. Repay 0.

name: Cellulase Burst
effect: One-shot: search your draw deck for any 1 basic card, draw it for free, shuffle the deck. Then exhaust.
flavor: Cellulase floods the substrate, dissolving cell walls to release exactly the sugar the colony is hunting for.
notes: Tutor for a specific basic (the Grow / Add-Substrate / Phosphorus-Tap you need THIS round). Consistency, not card advantage: net deck shrinks by the drawn card, nudging depletion forward. Strong when you must line up an exact action now (e.g. a tap before ants eat a pile); a waste when any basic would do, since a plain paid draw is cheaper than buying this. Exhausts; not recycled; repay 0 (not an engine).

name: Sporulating Bloom
effect: One-shot: search your COLLECTION for any 1 premium card you do not own this level and add a copy to your HAND, then add 4 Grow basics to your draw deck. Then exhaust.
flavor: A fruiting flush releases a spore cloud that founds new colonies, a desperate, expensive broadcast of the genome.
notes: Late-game tutor/runway payoff: fetch the exact premium swing you need (a finishing dig, a defense, a converter) plus a little Grow runway to actually deploy it. Heavy power is gated by 3 Nitrogen (R5 flat gate, not buy price, which is the locked flat 14), so it demands prior worm-fighting and is a trap early when you can neither afford the N nor know what to fetch. The fetched card STILL costs its own W/P/N to play, so this is no free auto-win. Adds NEW Grow basics; the fetched card is the tutor half. Exhausts; not recycled; repay 0. Buy dropped from 28 to flat 14; power now lives entirely in the 3-N gate and late timing.

name: Rhizomorph Lance
effect: EXHAUST. Pick a direction: instantly extend your network 6 cells in a straight line through open substrate from the network edge that way, free of the normal per-cell grow steps.
flavor: A rhizomorph — a rope of bundled hyphae — shoots ahead as a pre-built transport cord.
notes: Pure distance tempo, W-gated 2, flat 14. Directional growth (R3b/R8): player aims the vector, NOT toward-the-goal pathing. growthAmount 6. Great mid to close on a far pile; weak early, risky late if it overshoots. The single mobility extend (the goal-finisher extend is Fruiting Vigil, distinct payoff). repayRounds 0.

name: Hyphal Autolysis
effect: EXHAUST. Sacrifice: discard the top 2 cards of your draw deck to gain +26 energy immediately. If your draw deck is empty, gain nothing.
flavor: The colony cannibalizes its own aging hyphae, autolysing them for a surge of nutrients.
notes: Trades runway (your clock) for energy NOW: net +12 over buy but -2 deck depth. The DECK-SACRIFICE burst: it offers more raw energy than the gentler bursts precisely because it accelerates depletion, so it is non-dominating against them — Osmotic Cashout/Hyphal Investment for safety, Autolysis when deck depth no longer matters (strong late, self-harm early). Discards to graveyard (only extenders add NEW basics). GLOBAL. repayRounds 0.

name: Mycorrhizal Windfall
effect: EXHAUST. Trigger an off-pile draft on the spot: see 5 cards from your collection and keep up to 2, paying the normal flat 14 per kept card. Requires no food pile.
flavor: A mycorrhizal handshake with a plant root trades sugars for a sudden bounty of options.
notes: Acquisition without routing to a pile, P-gated 2, flat-14 buy. You still pay the flat 14 per keep, so it demands banked energy — a mid swing, a trap if you're broke or out of good targets. Mirrors a large-pile draft (see 5 / keep 2) but on demand. GLOBAL. repayRounds 0.

name: Constricting Snare
effect: EXHAUST. Tap a point: within a radius of 60 world-units, spring adhesive trapping loops and instantly kill up to 3 nematodes inside it. Each killed worm yields its normal +2 Nitrogen.
flavor: Arthrobotrys constricting rings clamp shut on every nematode passing through the zone.
notes: Cheap radius defense that also feeds N (up to +6 N). R7: RADIUS-around-a-tap (radius 60) so targeting is phone-legal and explicit. Tension: pop it now to stop strand loss, or wait for a denser worm cluster in one radius to bank more N? Useless with no worms in range. produces N (incidental from kills, not a per-round engine). targeting radius. repayRounds 0.

name: Hydrophobin Surge
effect: EXHAUST. For the next 2 rounds, all your grow and dig actions advance double the cells per step. (A burst of free traversal speed, not extra cards.)
flavor: Hydrophobin proteins coat advancing tips, slicking them through soil and water films.
notes: A tempo multiplier on growth you already do — only good with grow/dig cards queued to exploit the window. W-gated 1, flat 14. Wasted with no growth to spend; that opportunity cost keeps it honest. Effect is a flat doubling of cells-per-step (R5: not a % buff, a fixed x2 multiplier on the existing grow step). GLOBAL (whole-network buff, no tap). repayRounds 0.

name: Spore Salvo
effect: EXHAUST. Convert decay into fuel: gain +18 energy AND +1 Nitrogen now. The Nitrogen pushes against your soft cap of 6.
flavor: A salvo of spores germinates on surrounding litter, the colony reaping the burst of decomposition.
notes: N-GATED 2 cashout (+18 energy) that ALSO hands back +1 N — the gate plus the resource swing is its identity. Non-dominating against the ungated drip (Hyphal Investment) and the deck-sacrifice burst (Hyphal Autolysis): it needs N you may want elsewhere but returns some. Best on worm-heavy runs where N overflows anyway. R5 flat. GLOBAL. repayRounds 0.

name: Fruiting Vigil
effect: EXHAUST. Endgame finisher: pick the goal direction and instantly extend up to 8 cells that way; if a tip reaches the GOAL zone this play, fruit immediately and win the level. Otherwise just the extension lands.
flavor: The colony pours everything into a single primordium, racing to fruit before the soil runs dry.
notes: The premier endgame swing: closes a near-final gap and skips the surface-and-fruit steps. Heavy mixed W 2 + N 2 gate forces resource sequencing; dead weight any time you are not within ~8 cells of the goal (no auto-include). Directional extend the player aims at the goal zone (R8: player-aimed, the one finisher case, not obstacle-pathing). growthAmount 8. flat-14 buy. targeting directional. repayRounds 0.

name: Cordyceps Vault
effect: Install. Each round, metabolize buried substrate for +3 energy; on any round in which you harvested or digested substrate, it yields +4 instead. No resource gate. Counts toward the engine energy ceiling.
flavor: A dense stroma quietly metabolizing buried substrate, surging when fresh matter is broken down.
notes: REVIEWER FIX (high - was a strictly-better-timed duplicate of Rhizomorph Trunkline +4 flat): re-spec'd to +3 base with a +4 ACTIVE-PLAY rider (any round you harvested or digested) so it rewards routing/digesting rather than duplicating Trunkline's raw flat +4. repayRounds dropped 4->3 (light band). Per-engine produce.energy<=4 (caps at 4 only on active rounds) so it never breaks the per-engine ceiling; counts toward the runtime sum<12 clamp (invariants 3/5). No W/P/N gate (no double-tax). Distinct identity from Trunkline (pure flat +4, mid) = active-play conditional, early.

name: Imbibition Surge
effect: One-shot. If your frontier is lake-adjacent, harvest +5 Water immediately (does NOT consume a lake harvest charge). If not lake-adjacent, the card is UNPLAYABLE (greyed out).
flavor: A burst of osmotic uptake flooding the cords with turgor in one pulse.
notes: The cheap one-shot WATER burst, mirroring Apatite Dissolution (P). Hyphal Imbibition basic gives only +2 W; this +5 fills the burst-access gap so all three resources have a cheap burst. UNPLAYABLE when not lake-adjacent (no do-nothing fallback) - positional timing tension, never an auto-include. With lakeCountMax=1, routing to the single lake is the whole decision. +5 fits softCap 6.

name: Picket Hyphae
effect: Install. Each round, ants harvest 2 fewer leaves from EVERY food pile adjacent to your frontier, so more of each pile's energy and its draft survive for you. Produces no energy.
produces: ant-slow: 2 fewer leaves taken/round per adjacent pile
flavor: A standing picket line of fans physically crowding ants off the caches.
notes: REVIEWER FIX (low - was implicitly single-target 'nearest pile', borderline R7): reworded to GLOBAL over EVERY adjacent food pile (no selection). R5 already applied: flat '2 fewer leaves/round' not a %. The persistent anti-ant engine, giving ants the per-threat engine answer mould (Melanized Sheath) and worms (Arthrobotrys Snare) already have. Defense engine, NO energy output -> EXEMPT from the energy ceiling. Repay 3 via pile energy/drafts recovered on ant-heavy maps; near-dead on ant-light maps = the draft read.

name: Trail Hijack
effect: One-shot. Resolves on the nearest ant trail your network is touching: convert it into a conductive cord - instantly extend your frontier along its full length AND gain +12 energy from the forage the ants had cached on it. UNPLAYABLE if no ant trail is touched.
flavor: Repurposing the ants' pheromone highway as your own pre-built rhizomorph.
notes: REVIEWER NOTE (low, clarity-only): +12 is INTENDED on a conditionally-gated one-shot - high magnitude justified by the ant-trail gate (UNPLAYABLE unless a trail touches you = no do-nothing fallback). R7 FIX retained: no 'choose one trail' selection - auto-resolves on the NEAREST touched trail (global). Turns the ant race into upside, mirroring the worm->N loop. +12 refunds buy + a draw; the free extension (skips a dig) is the real value. Gives ants the route/trail-clearing answer they lacked.

name: Foxfire Glow
effect: One-shot. Bioluminesce: reveal all map features (food piles, the lake, formations, rock columns, threat nests) within a wide radius of your frontier, and mark the route to the nearest unrevealed food pile.
flavor: Luciferin-driven foxfire glow lighting the dark tunnels (Armillaria, Mycena, Omphalotus).
notes: Owns the under-served routing/scouting axis with real biology (bioluminescent wood-rot fungi). Value peaks EARLY when the route is unknown; near-dead LATE once the map is explored = the timing read. No resource gate. RADIUS reveal around the frontier (the wide-radius variant of the radius targeting mode). No other card does pure feature reveal.

name: Demarcation Line
effect: Install. Each round, extend a melanized zone line one cell along every boundary where your network meets a threat colony (ant trail OR mould cloud), blocking that threat's spread across the line. Produces no energy.
flavor: Somatic incompatibility: where two colonies reject each other a black zone line forms.
notes: Uses melanized zone lines (somatic incompatibility), unused elsewhere. Flexible cheap defense engine vs BOTH ants and mould (threat:all), resolving globally on every threat boundary. Defense engine, EXEMPT from the energy ceiling. Repay 3 on contested maps; weaker than a dedicated single-threat engine on a mono-threat map = the draft tension.

name: Autophagic Sprint
effect: One-shot. Cannibalize older hyphae for a burst: gain +16 energy now, but PERMANENTLY raise your SKIP cost by 2 for the rest of the level. (Skip only ever goes UP - this never lowers it.)
flavor: Autophagy: recycling your own cytoplasm into a forward sprint at lasting cost.
notes: CONSOLIDATION re-cost (was +24, an early auto-include): dropped to +16 so the permanent skip-raise downside actually bites. R10 bans skip-cost REDUCERS only; this RAISES skip (never lowers), so it cannot interact with any reducer to break the engine-ceiling invariant. A genuine risk/reward card on the TIME axis (steeper card-dry bleed). Strongest EARLY (few future skips); late it is a trap. Downside axis distinct from Necrotic Tithe (spatial: frontier cells).

name: Necrotic Tithe
effect: One-shot. Slough off living tissue for instant fuel: gain +18 energy now, but the outermost 4 cells of your frontier die back immediately (the network shrinks at its leading edge).
flavor: Programmed cell death at the margin, recycling the membrane lipids into a cash burst.
notes: Second risk/reward downside card the framework asks for. Distinct downside AXIS from Autophagic Sprint: this pays a SPATIAL cost (4 frontier cells regrown later) rather than a time/skip cost. +18 energy now vs lost reach = strongest EARLY when 4 cells are cheap to regrow and the energy compounds; a trap LATE near the goal when every frontier cell matters. Global die-back at the leading edge (no node selection, R7-safe). No resource gate.

name: Saprophytic Reclaim
effect: One-shot. RADIUS-around-a-tap (radius 75): tap a point; clear every rotted/infected cell of YOUR network inside the radius and convert the decay into +3 Nitrogen. UNPLAYABLE if no rotted cell is inside the radius.
flavor: Turning the infection inward: saprotrophy on your own necrotic tissue, banked as nitrogen.
notes: CONSOLIDATION fix (was a whole-network clear, violating R9): now RADIUS-around-a-tap (radius 75), the phone-first cleanse model. mould->N one-shot recovery: cleanses self-rot in the radius and banks it as N (recovery + fuel in one). Distinct from Mycoparasitic Reversal (a conditional ENGINE eating external clouds for N each round). UNPLAYABLE with no rot in radius (no do-nothing fallback) = situational, never auto-include. No play gate; the gate is having taken mould damage worth reclaiming.

name: Litter Drift
effect: Add Substrate (DIRECTIONAL, patchSize 3 = small). Pick a direction; drop a 3-cell nutrient patch at the EDGE of current sensing range that way. Once-per-2-rounds cooldown. Player controls direction only, never distance.
flavor: Wind-drifted leaf litter banks up into a small forage shelf at the colony's frontier.
notes: R3 substrate family, patchSize 3, the small premium rung above the basic specks. targeting=directional, cooldown 2. Repeatable routing tool: aim growth where you want without paying per-distance. No W/P/N gate (pure routing utility).

name: Forest-Floor Mantle
effect: Add Substrate (DIRECTIONAL, patchSize 10 = large). One-shot exhaust. Pick a direction; drop a 10-cell nutrient patch at the EDGE of current sensing range that way. Player controls direction only, never distance. Gate: 2 N.
flavor: An entire mat of forest-floor duff laid as a bridge — one decisive leap of the colonisation front.
notes: R3 substrate family CAPSTONE, patchSize 10, largest rung. targeting=directional, one-shot event. Gate 2 N. Caps the small->large substrate ladder (1/3/6/10). Big reach reserved for the decisive cross-gap commitment; gated so it isn't a casual play.

name: Sensory Sheath
effect: Install (sensing modifier). While installed, your sensing radius is +1 larger every round (substrate/attractor/rock detection reaches further). Does not produce energy or resources. Gate: 1 P.
flavor: A dense investment of receptor-bearing hyphal tips widens the colony's chemical horizon.
notes: R3b sensing-radius modifier engine. Non-energy engine (exempt from energy ceiling). repay 4 (utility value ~3.5/round-equiv). Light P gate. Makes every directional grow, substrate drop, and dig reach further by widening the sensing edge they key off. Distinct from growth tricks: it modifies the radius itself rather than growing.

name: Aphid Ranch
effect: Install (anti-ant engine with unconditional floor). Each round: if an ant trail or column is within sensing range, divert it and gain +2 energy (ant->upside loop). If NO ant is present, still gain +1 energy baseline. Energy engine.
produces: +1 energy/round baseline, +2/round when an ant is in range
flavor: The colony farms the ants' own honeydew aphids, turning a raiding column into a sugar supply.
notes: Fills TWO gaps: (1) anti-ant installed ENGINE with an ant->upside loop; (2) UNCONDITIONAL floor so it isn't dead on ant-free maps (mirrors Nematophagous Mat's worm-free floor). ENERGY engine: max +2/round (<=4, ceiling-safe), counts +2 toward the energy ceiling. repay 4. NOT W/P/N gated (energy engines aren't double-taxed, R12). Distinct from Trophallaxis Hijack/Picket Hyphae which idle when no ant is adjacent.

name: Pheromone Scramble
effect: RADIUS anti-ant (tap, radius 60). One-shot exhaust. Tap a point; scramble all ant trails inside the radius so ant columns re-path AWAY from your network for 2 rounds. Player controls only WHERE the tap lands. Gate: 1 P.
flavor: Counterfeit trail pheromones flood the area; the ants follow their own false roads off into the dark.
notes: Fills the missing RADIUS anti-ant cleanse/protect analog (ants previously had no radius-around-a-tap card the way mould has Hydrophobin Cleanse). targeting=radius, radius=60 (the canonical Amputate radius). One-shot event. Light P gate. Buys 2 rounds to harvest a contested pile before ants return.

name: Mycoparasite Harvest
effect: Install (mould->N conversion engine). Each round: if Trichoderma rot is within sensing range, consume one rot patch and gain +2 N (parasitize the parasite). If NO rot is present, gain +1 N baseline. Resource engine.
produces: +1 N/round baseline, +2 N/round when rot is in range
flavor: Hyphae coil around the invading mould and digest it, ammonifying the rot into clean nitrogen.
notes: Fills the mould->NITROGEN conversion engine gap (parasitize the parasite). RESOURCE engine (produces N, EXEMPT from energy ceiling). Unconditional +1 N floor so not dead on mould-light maps. repay 5 (resource engine band). NO W/P/N gate (no double-tax). Distinct from Mycoparasitic Reversal (the per-round infected-strand clearer) by being a durable rot->N faucet with a guaranteed baseline floor.

name: Condense
effect: Harvest Water (free basic): condense +1 W from ambient humidity into the stockpile (soft cap 6). No feature routing required.
flavor: Hydrophobic hyphal mats wick dew straight out of the night air.
notes: Free +1 W producer basic, the Water parallel to Mineralize (free +1 P) for W/P/N basic-floor parity. One-shot, not an engine (repay 0). Critical because Water is the scarce one-lake resource; this keeps W-gated cards from being dead on low-lake routing without breaking the harvest economy (only +1, vs +3 lake tap).

name: Ammonify
effect: Harvest Nitrogen (free basic): ammonify nearby decay into +1 N in the stockpile (soft cap 6). No nematode kill required.
flavor: Saprotrophic enzymes mineralise dead organic matter into ammonium.
notes: Free standalone +1 N producer basic (parallel to Mineralize free +1 P and Condense free +1 W) so the W/P/N basic floor has full parity and N is not only available via the Decay Forage Front extender. One-shot, not an engine (repay 0). Keeps N-gated cards alive on worm-free maps at the floor.

name: Spent Mat Combustion
effect: Install (risk energy engine). Gain +4 energy at the end of each round, BUT take +1 rot damage each round (one strand decays / becomes rot-vulnerable). Energy engine.
flavor: The colony cannibalises its own spent mat for a hot, fast burn that scorches the living edge.
notes: Fills the gap for a +4 energy engine WITH a downside, giving the fast repay-2 band real timing tension distinct from the no-gate +4 faucets (Trunkline/Cordyceps Vault). ENERGY engine: +4/round (==cap, ceiling-safe; counts +4 toward the energy ceiling). repay 2 (fast band). NO W/P/N gate (R12: energy engines balanced by magnitude + downside + clamp, not price/resources). The rot upkeep means you want it EARLY and may want to uninstall/offset it late.
